notes.title: [Notice] Character Creation Issue (Resolved)
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/d0f343240d222afcf346c478d79025ad8d836f7d.jpg"][/img]

Hello! This is an announcement from Soulworker.

We have identified an issue affecting character creation on certain servers. Currently, when attempting to use a character name that is already taken, no error message or prompt will appear.

Normally, you would receive a message indicating the name is unavailable, but due to this issue, no such notification is displayed.

If you get stuck on the character creation screen, please assume that your preferred name is already taken. You should be able to proceed by entering a different name that has not yet been used.

Our team is working on fixing this as soon as possible.

Notes:
- Affected servers: EN and TC
- CN servers are not affected

We apologize for the inconvenience and appreciate your patience.

notes.title: [Notice] Transaction Restriction System Changes (08/07/25)
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/d0f343240d222afcf346c478d79025ad8d836f7d.jpg"][/img]

Hello! This is an announcement from Soulworker.

We would like to inform you of the changes made to the following item-related restrictions for accounts, which were applied in March and May 2025.

[b]Affected Features:[/b]
- Trade (1:1 Transaction)
- Mail (H.E.M.S)
- Market
- League Storage

[b]### Restriction Changes[/b]

[b]- Before Update:[/b]
※ You can view the previously implemented transaction restrictions in the announcement below:

[Notice] Transaction Restriction System Changes (05/15/25)
[url=https://vfun-lounge.valofe.com/page/soulworker/Notice/25733][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/e72f5c83e0e7a918a48e45f4715ceaa05a522974.jpg"][/img][/url]

[b]- After the Update:[/b]
※ The following features require the character to be Level 85:
  - 1:1 Trading
  - Mail (H.E.M.S)
  - Market

※ The features listed below will be restricted for 30 days after an account's first Cash Shop purchase:
  - This applies to:
    - Accounts created after the August 7 update
    - Accounts created before August 7 that have never made a Cash Shop purchase

    [b]Restricted features:[/b]
    - 1:1 Trading
    - Mail (H.E.M.S)
    - Market
    - League Storage

[b]Note:[/b]
- If your 30-day restriction is still active, you may not be able to wrap costumes.
- The 30-day countdown will now be displayed on your Profile menu.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/5c894763ebadcf89e036252078fbd7747537a060.png"][/img]

[b]### Amendments FAQ[/b]

[b]#1[/b]

[b]Question:[/b]
- I made my first Cash Shop purchase on July 21. Will the 60-day restriction still apply after the August 7 update?

[b]Answer:[/b]
- No. Starting August 7, the 60-day restriction will be shortened by 30 days.

[b]Example:[/b]
- Before August 7 Policy:
  - Account Created: April 13
  - Purchase Date: July 21
  - Item Restriction: 60-day countdown begins
  - Transaction Restriction: 60-day countdown begins
  - Both restrictions end: September 21

[b]- After August 7 Policy:[/b]
  - A 30-day reduction will be applied to the transaction restriction.
  - New Transaction Restriction End Date: August 21

[b]#2[/b]

[b]Question:[/b]
- What happens to accounts that have already completed the Transaction Policy before the March 2025 update?

[b]Answer:[/b]
- If your account already fulfilled the initial transaction requirement (e.g., first Cash Shop purchase completed before March 2025), you will retain full access to the following features without further restrictions:
  - 1:1 Trading
  - Mail (H.E.M.S)
  - Market
  - League Storage

[b]Example:[/b]
- An old account that met the first-purchase condition
- Made a Cash Shop purchase by July 10
- After the August 7 update, no transaction restrictions will be displayed on the account[/p]

tags.balance_change: - No. Starting August 7, the 60-day restriction will be shortened by 30 days.

notes.title: [Notice] 24/08/08 Update Note Preview
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/9ba849641b07edd1b47b99a83e979e778ea32c36.jpg[/img]

Hello! This is an announcement from Soulworker.
Here is the news for the August 8th, 2024 update!

[h3]◆ Changes ◆[/h3]

▶ Continuation of Story

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/c0b320e47684db76fa310787941d1e5388e4bb4d.png[/img]
- 16 new main story quests have been added.
- [Arcadia Realm - EP 2.5. Prelude to War] The 'Recapture Etheldreda' maze will be added.
- You can enter the 'Recapture Etheldreda' maze through [Arcadia Realm - NPC Rona].

- After completing [Main Quest - The Cost of Betrayal], you can proceed with the main story through [Arcadia Realm - NPC Heitz].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/4cc2c2da062c694d0e1212c16ba51e47b7d032b9.png[/img]
1) Increased Maximum Level - 85 (Already applied in the August 1st maintenance)
- The maximum character level has been increased from level 82 to level 85.
- The existing level 72 skill has been increased from level 4 to level 5. See the changes below:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/74c8f24039f38506eeb6a31583f7771b2b976089.png[/img]

- Mastery Level Expansion.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/11af3add71225507c6c1512ee0587a9b4a34e29f.png[/img]

2) Added Region Progress Rewards
[Arcadia Realm - EP 2.5. Prelude to War] 'Recapture Etheldreda' Maze
When cleared, you can obtain the 'Arcadia Realm Token' item.

▶ Others

1. The maze field of vision has been expanded for specific Mazes.
- Garden of Plenty
- Field of Raid
- Endless Wasteland

2. Added 5 new dye options for the "Romance of the Sea" costume

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/68e34575a5487ee0b7ee09235d8647075ed031e1.png[/img]
Dye Probability Table:
https://vfun-lounge.valofe.com/page/soulworker/ItemProbability/16283


3. Adjusted Violent Sun Hero Item Drop Table

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/ad406b1eff642d7dadfa56536fc73ce7ac736efe.png[/img]

Items Removed:
[Lv.82] HERO Familiar Random Box
Energy Converter

Note: We have received feedback regarding the [Lv.82] HERO Familiar Random Box not dropping. Please be assured that the item is indeed dropping as intended, but its drop rate is very low, leading to the perception that it might not be on the drop table. Due to the extremely low drop rate, the team has decided to remove the item. Rest assured that we are working diligently to improve the drop rates and craftable items in the Hero Maze.

[h3]◆ Item Shop ◆[/h3]

▶ Costumes and Speech Bubbles!

Period:
August 8th, 15:00 PM ~ September 5th, 10:00 AM KST
August 7th, 10:00 PM ~ September 4th, 17:00 PM PST
August 8th, 06:00 AM ~ September 5th, 01:00 AM GMT

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/56b30c16f77614046ea2f29c7c756382917880d5.png[/img]

1. [Costume PKG] GPX Punk Racer
- Soul Cash Price: 1520

2. [FULL PKG] GPX Punk Racer
- Soul Cash Price: 2130

3. [GPX Punk Racer] Speech Bubble
- Soul Cash Price: 570

Available for:
All Characters

4. [Costume PKG] Sunnyday Vacance
- Soul Cash Price: 2100 (For Lily - 2600 Soul Cash)

Available for:
All Characters

5. [Costume PKG] Hot Summer Swimsuit – Permanently added to Cash Shop
- Soul Cash Price: 1600

Available for:
Haru, Erwin, Lily, Stella, Jin, and Iris

▶ Other

1. Soul Jumping Ticket – Permanently added to Cash Shop
- Soul Cash Price: 1500
Use 'Soul Jumping Ticket' → INSTANT LEVEL UP → Lv. 76

▶ Transmissions

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/87a7e22591c7835653707a55c27fd71d7858e8cc.png[/img]

▶ Beneris and Relfenne Akashic Record Rate UP!
> Cash Shop → Transmission → Akashic Record
- The probability of acquiring Beneris and Relfenne will increase during the period.
   - When a 5-star appears, there is a 25% chance to acquire Beneris and a 25% Relfenne to acquire Lucy.
- Special [Rate Up] Transmission → Do not provide Transmission x1 FREE chance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/054736b5767e92848ef224fd027afd2a6e83c007.png[/img]

▶ Miriam Soul Mate Rate UP!
> Cash Shop → Transmission → Soul Mate
- The probability of acquiring Miriam will increase during the period.
   - When an S-grade appears, there is a 50% chance to acquire Miriam.
- Special [Rate Up] Transmission → Do not provide Transmission x1 FREE chance.

Note: The pickup transfer for Akashic Record and Soul Mate will be available from after the maintenance on August 8th (Thursday) until before the maintenance on September 5th Update (Thursday).

[h3]◆ Events ◆[/h3]

▶ Login Event (Golden Labyrinth Eve Event) - Not Available on Server Kent (CN)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/f649a54dc6b2029cec5f897805215a72149b84bd.png[/img]

1) Event Period: August 8th Update ~ September 5th Update
2) Event Information:
- By logging in, you can receive various items.
- To ensure you receive all rewards, including the final event rewards, make sure to log in to the game during the event period for at least 7 days.

Navigation: Login Check -> Golden Labyrinth Eve

<Reward List>
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/a062123b88a26aafec80a894e973179696298b17.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/5069115386eb9f199c3a4c0e9c75e1d5bc50a024.png[/img]

※ All login rewards will be delivered to the H.E.M.S account mailbox.
※ If you have not received the mail, please refresh to check the mail for workers who have logged in before the reset time.
※ H.E.M.S are limited to a maximum of 50, and if the maximum number of 50 messages is exceeded, you can delete existing messages to view new ones.

▶ Rumble Vacation (Event Maze) - Not Available on Server Kent (CN)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/6c909dcf6a75443f9e5f6837d2fe646044f543b1.jpg[/img]
1) Event Period: August 8th Update ~ September 5th Update
2) Event Information:
- Event Maze [Rumble Vacation]: This can be entered by using [Warp Orb] Rumble Vacation.
> Character Level Requirement: Lv. 30 or Higher
> [Warp Orb] Rumble Vacation: Enable to purchase at Gruton Coin Shop (Price: Gruton Coin x30) / Can purchase thrice a day per account
- Maze Cleared → Can obtain [EV] Ripe Watermelon
> [EV] Ripe Watermelon: Can be exchanged for various items at Gruton Coin Shop → Craft → Event I

<Event Production List>
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/6dc43a015eac280f9068ede66093dc02050e3949.png[/img]

★ [PLEASE NOTE] ★
- [EV] Ripe Watermelon / [Limited] Items:
> Must be used before the September 5th Update. Otherwise, it will be automatically deleted.

▶ Daily Mission Event - [EV] Watermelon Juice

1) Event Period: August 8th Update ~ September 5th Update
2) Event Information:
- By completing daily missions, you can obtain [EV] Watermelon Juice.
- You can exchange this item for various items in the [Event II] tab of the NPC Gruton.
Note: [EV] Watermelon Juice and [Limited] items can be used until the maintenance on September 5th. After the expiration period, they will be automatically deleted.

<Daily Mission List>
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/666189f52cabe9fe9e29b99aa17e392ecf620d57.png[/img]

<Event Production List>
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/bd90f4639c927ad2262c7b0e535534d4cf7064e0.png[/img]

[h3]◆Upcoming◆[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/c56cb6362f017640bf63d508aaf1591948f10d06.png[/img]

We are excited to announce that Soulworker is expanding its services to China! After the scheduled maintenance on Thursday, August 22, 2024, we will launch a new server called CN[Kent]. This new server is designed to offer a better and improved environment for our Chinese players and will feature exciting events running until September 5, 2024. Furthermore, the game will now have Simplified Chinese localization to support the Kent Server launch.

Furthermore, we would like to share a few things to look up in Soulworker!

1. Golden Labyrinth 
In the Golden Labyrinth content, a total of 50 new pieces of equipment will be added.

2. Golden Labyrinth Weapons

notes.title: [Notice] 24/02/21 Development update of Soulworker
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/757a1b6a05608f23b618095734082db46191f0e0.png[/img]

Hello! This is an announcement from SoulWorker.

We would like to inform you about the current development status of SoulWorker.

The transition progress is running smoothly and we plan to complete it by February. Further updates will be released sequentially from March onwards. 

We are also excited to announce some of the content which is currently in progress.

[b]Future Updates:[/b]

[b]Content:[/b]
- Addition of Hidden Hideout: Heroic Mode, entry-level 82 / number of participants: 1~4 players. 
Once the raid is opened, this content can be participated in indefinitely.
- Golden Maze (Tentative name): Additional content necessary for expanding functions of reinforcement will be scheduled. 
- A new maze will be added at Episode 2.5. With the addition of the new story, the level will be raised to 85 and the Mastery Level will be adjusted too.
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/67b2734890713e40be4566b6f99873f93ed50489.png[/img]

[b]Future Sale Items:[/b]
- [Dhana] The Lord of Dark Forces 

[b]System changes related:[/b]
- DirectX 11 Support: We are going to apply updates for DirectX to provide better game optimization. With updates in DirectX 11, gameplay in an improved environment will be applied where several characters and NPCs appear simultaneously. 
※ Depending on the condition of gameplay, there are cases where it may not be possible to experience the effects.
- Skill adjustment: Skill balance will be adjusted for all characters.
- Upgrade: The maximum enhancement value will be increased from +9 to +15.
- Scheduled addition of Mystic Akashic Records [Tenebris]

Regarding the update schedule, we are currently adjusting it, so we will inform everyone once the details are decided.

Furthermore, we will be re-running past in-game events to make it easier for players to strengthen their equipment that can be obtained from the current content until the next update.

Once again, we apologize for keeping everyone waiting. In the future, we will keep you informed of the development status and update the schedule to the extent that it can be disclosed.

Thank you for your cooperation.

notes.title: [Notice] Trade Restriction System Change - Cash Shop Product
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/757a1b6a05608f23b618095734082db46191f0e0.png[/img]

Hello, this is SoulWorker Operation Team.
Changes in the Trading Restriction Mechanism for Cash Items purchased in the Cash Shop will be applied sequentially through the first (Dec 7th) and second (Dec 21st) updates in December, 2023.
The details are as follows:

[Current Restriction Mechanism]
※ Users with More than 51 Cumulative Attendance days (ACCOUNT BASIS): 
> Purchase Costumes and Costume PKG → [Can be Traded]

※ Users with Less than 51 Cumulative Attendance days (ACCOUNT BASIS): 
> Purchase Costumes and Costume PKG → [Cannot be Traded: For 30 Days]

[Amended Restriction Mechanism]
※ Trading [b](Market/Personal Transaction/H.E.M.S)[/b] is restricted for 30 days after the first purchase of Cash Items in the Cash Shop. (ACCOUNT BASIS)
> Accounts with a record of purchasing Cash Items in Cash Shop [after October 2nd, 2020] can use the trading system normally.
> For accounts with NO record of purchasing Cash Items in Cash Shop [after October 2nd, 2020], the trading system will be restricted for 30 days upon the first purchase of Cash Items in Cash Shop.

※ The minimum level required to use the Trading Function is raised to Level 82. (ACCOUNT BASIS) [b](Already Applied on December 7th Update)[/b]

※ The Trading Restriction Mechanism applied after February 23rd Update will be DELETED.
> [Trading allowed for more than 51 days of Cumulative Attendance and 30-day Trading Restriction for less than 51 days of Cumulative Attendance] will be DELETED.

[Application Date]
- After the December 21st Update

[b]* More details of the new Trading Restriction Mechanism will be announced through ‘[Notice] 231221 Update Note Preview’.[/b]

To create a fair gaming culture, SoulWorker keeps monitoring abnormal gameplay, including continuously abusing in-game systems and illegal programs. 
Please keep in mind that any actions found violating the operating policy and taking advantage of unfair means will lead to restriction of your gameplay.

We will always do our best to provide a smooth and comfortable gaming environment.

We hope that there will be no confusion due to the above changes. 

Thank you for your love and support for our game. SoulWorker will try to provide a better service for our users.

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/a117b6e9924568a62686ccb2cbfd1d9128bc352a.png[/img]


[b]Hello! This is an announcement from SoulWorker.
Here is the Update and Event News for September 7, 2023.[/b]

[b]---------------------------------------------◆ UPDATE ◆---------------------------------------------[/b]

[b]◆ UPDATE RECAP[/b]
- New Raid [Vile Predator]
- Raid Balance Patch for [Tragic Fairy]

[b]▶ NEW RAID UPDATE – VILE PREDATOR[/b]
- [Vile Predator] Raid will be updated.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/36ae2c3c055550f2bc4146cf458014ff3c04ac64.png[/img]

- Vile Predator related Quest will be added in Arcadia Realm.
> Quest: The End of Evolution
> Clear ‘Encounter with Evolution’ Quest → Enable to receive [The End of Evolution] Quest

[b][ HOW TO ENTER ][/b]
* Must Complete ‘Encounter with Evolution’ Quest
→ Enable to enter [Operation Stratos] District by clicking the Icon
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/d67df0f8d10f430df878f5f17750dcadf01acb99.png[/img]
(Operation Stratos Icon)




[b][ RAID INFO ][/b]

< Hall of Flames >
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/5ae24cdbdb42c4a173b33fcf67c09d61677f75cd.jpg[/img]


< Scarlet Madness >
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/141c2a77aec90896a2dc856ad0e8a0b3a243fb6d.jpg[/img]


< Howling Fang >
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/a9856d9bab9e851d47786ff2063480927cad5f58.jpg[/img]


< Evolving Habitation >
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/c43f895e36210d5053648c98d8dded9c5139c881.jpg[/img]

< Operation Stratos  (District)>
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/ce7bce03cc83d3e00ca557f5da33421b3e36f160.jpg[/img]


[b][HOW TO CREATE SQUAD][/b]
- Please go to the Raid District, "Operation Stratos" in order to play the "Vile Predator" Raid.
- "Operation Stratos" is used as a waiting area platform where users are able to control number of people, level of Raids, as well as leaving / re-entering the Maze.
- When creating a Squad, said Character will be set as the Squad Leader in which she/he can edit and start Raids.
- ‘Story Playback’ function cannot be activated in "Operation Stratos" district.



[b][RAID STRUCTURE][/b]
- Mazes in the Vile Predator
> (Sub Maze) Hall of Flames <Boss: Flemma>
> (Sub Maze) Scarlet Madness <Boss: Relfenne>
> (Sub Maze) Howling Fang <Boss: Gale>
> (Main Maze) Evolving Habitation <Boss: Vista>

- Normal (1 Player Only) / Hard (1~12 Players)
- Not Possible to Use [Active] Akashic Records

- HARD difficulty: 3 Parties
> Team [1]: Max 4 Team Members
> Team [2]: Max 4 Team Members
> Team [3]: Max 4 Team Members
> Sub Parties (Hall of Flames / Scarlet Madness / Howling Fang) → Defeat Flemma / Relfenne / Gale to gain Buffs for Entire Teams & gain Debuffs to weaken Vista
> Main Party (Evolving Habitation) → Try to Defeat Vista
- Each Maze of "Vile Predator" has a Re-Spawn limit of 3 times (Exception: Daily free Re-Spawn, Cash Re-Spawn).


[b][SQUAD FINDER][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/f2601d373f0fe299d167ab693bd390ef73926f65.png[/img]

- Game Menu Icon [Squad Finder]: Enable to check Squad Lists
- Can [Apply] a Squad that you want to Join.
- Squad Leader: Can Accept or Decline a Squad Join Request from Squad Applicant.
- Squad can consist of at least 1 user and a maximum of 12.
- In order for smooth gameplay in Vile Predator, 12 users are Highly Recommended in a Squad.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/a6fd80c2aa5ade6fb6dd3fade1e5ce7f2806af9f.png[/img]

[b][SQUAD TEAM ORGANIZATION][/b]
- The Squad Leader is able to edit the Squad and put members into different Parties.
- The Squad is only editable BEFORE the start of the Raid.
- The First member of each TEAM within the Squad, the Team Leader, can start the Raid.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/42136bbdfa31c227e7957f31622a095e5b70411c.png[/img]

                              < Before Team Organization > / <After Team Organization>


[b][RAID START][/b]
- Starting the Raid is possible through NPC [Rona] in [Operation Stratos].
- Starting a Raid is only possible when joined in a Squad.
- Starting the Raid is only possible by the Squad Leader.
- Another Raid cannot be started once one has been started.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/6f83cab4cfee9e8dbd684276005f960d92180ff5.png[/img]



[b]▶ RAID PROGRESS BOARD[/b]

- When entering the Raid, clicking the icon next to Character Status UI at the top, the Raid Progress Board can be seen.
- Clicking the "Home" button on your keyboard will also allow you to see the Raid Progress Board after the Raid has started.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/dd5c2d20afc468ddc32c10311e06db090b1ac4e3.png[/img]


- A Maze activated in the Raid Progress Board UI can be entered by clicking it.
- Entering Mazes is only possible by Each Team Leader.
- All Raid progress can be tracked on the Raid Progress Board. After time has run out, the Raid is deemed a failure.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/81430365fd79c6577b42c5274b58263368befbe2.png[/img]



[b]▶ MAZE PARTY (TEAM) OCCUPANCY[/b]

- Only one(1) party can enter one(1) Maze at a time and the current Party in each Maze is shown.
- Another Party cannot enter a Maze once another Party has entered.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/714beeada403255379160370bd0845c3bc1f6a2c.png[/img]



[b]▶ MAIN MAZE[/b]

- Once the Main Maze is cleared, the Raid is deemed a Success.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/b383f8ef0568c8db929bfcfa87c8a61248390f9a.png[/img]


[b]▶ NORMAL MAZE[/b]

- Normal Mazes are all Mazes that are not the Main Maze.
- After clearing a Normal Maze, it will allow another Maze to open and/or give Buffs to other Mazes.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/49de83e98a568d7bc6dc622f06a764de64651bd5.png[/img]



[b]▶ LOCKED MAZE[/b]

- Locked Mazes cannot be entered at that moment.
- Once requirements for locked Mazes are met, they will be unlocked.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/0bc5c5f9acf4b1cd46c588de787297fb36250769.png[/img]



[b]▶ COMBAT SUPPORT SKILLS[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/80029b3a1bcab16c8e4164d3757c77f5a8e9e098.png[/img]

- Combat Support Skills are Available Only in Certain Mazes. (e.g. Vile Predator - Evolving Habitation)
- Combat Support Skills provide various help in clearing the maze.
- Combat Support Skills may be different for each maze.
- Combat Support Skill UI can be found At the Bottom of the Mini-Map when you enter the Combat Support Skill Available Maze.
- Evolving Habitation Maze (Combat Support Skill Lists): Can be checked at [Raid Progress Board].
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/5b78820b5fcbd409cb88804f5af2e041801e5533.png[/img]



[b]▶ [COMBAT SUPPORT SKILL]  SKILL METER[/b]

- Combat Support Skill Meter will rise if a Special Action is performed, or if Time has passed.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/a5ac5061220ce34db659978892b838e088c7085f.png[/img]


- When the Skill Meter is MAX → Enable to use Combat Support Skill
- Combat Support Skill Meter will be Reset if you leave a Maze. 


[b]▶ [COMBAT SUPPORT SKILL]  SKILL ACTIVATION[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/ef4cd9655c1da8e4e996555884cd0ef0a3c262fb.png[/img]


- Combat Support Skill / Skill Meter are shared by party members and can be activated by any party member.
- There will be Max 3 Combat Support Skills in the Maze. Enable to select one of the skills to use when the skill meter (Max) is reached.
- Combat Support Skill is triggered in the Direction the Character is Looking at, and it doesn't interfere with the character's action.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/9b1c37bd81cc518b3a98d468abc31b41e1f0420c.png[/img]


- Skill Meter: 100% → Use Combat Support Skill → Skill Meter: 0%
- To Use the Combat Support Skill again → You need to make Skill Meter [ 100% ] again. 


[b]▶ [COMBAT SUPPORT SKILL] ADDITIONAL INFORMATION[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/724c393912680b3a8aea12b50e412e9015da9d28.png[/img]

- Combat Support Skill (Default Settings): Keyboard [Ctrl] + 1 / 2 / 3
- Enable to change it under Key Settings (Hotkeys) in Settings.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/aa96e022282b8dc0e1440de10474720201790de7.png[/img]

- Hover your Mouse Cursor over the Combat Support Skill icon → Enable to check a Description of the Skill


[b]▶ [COMBAT SUPPORT SKILL] Evolving Habitation MAZE COMBAT SUPPORT SKILL LISTS[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/2df7a3fb9687a40e99bf14adfcb9e30468cfefd5.png[/img]

[b]▶ RAID REWARDS[/b]

- Once the Raid is finished successfully, all members of the Squad will get Rewards through H.E.M.S.
- If a user no longer has another chance to receive Rewards, Rewards will not be given.


[b][ Drop Rate: 100% (after Raid Clear) ][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/bdad459b3bcc3cd44c2da67b846e4370c856ab12.png[/img]
[b][ Drop Rate: Low ~ Very Low (after Raid Clear) ][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/e5d7a5e09ffbfe54894e29565394796e8a1004f5.png[/img]
[b]▶ RAID [VILE PREDATOR] - BACKGROUND FILM[/b]
- [Hall of Flames] Background Film
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/b8fa7463c431bbbf45b46de7c7e3a8ed38a5c8e1.png[/img]

- [Scarlet Madness] Background Film
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/5bf734e5d1a7553552ad6cf8575e0fd7e5c51238.png[/img]

- [Howling Fang] Background Film
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/61ccd8d4f425aa35791576cb33068945ddb9f3eb.png[/img]


[b]▶ REWARD LIMIT[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/3af716892b353a2688bbeb9566414ec5f3a2aec1.png[/img]


- Rewards can be accepted 2 times a Week, and Once Daily.
- Reward Limits are cut only after the Raid is cleared.
- Entering a Raid even when Rewards Acceptance limit is full is possible.
- Rewards cannot be received even if Raid is cleared when Rewards Acceptance limit is full.
- "Reward Limit [Weekly]" is refreshed every Monday at 01:00 GMT.
- "Reward Limit [Daily]" is refreshed every day at 01:00 GMT.


[b]▶ RAID [VILE PREDATOR] – NEW WEAPON / GEAR / ACCESSORY[/b]

[b]- [Insidious] Weapon / Gear will be added in the Nostalgic Weapon / Gear Succession Lists[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/671199f4154cc49db818ec4f9768e1dcf909418c.png[/img]

[b]▶ ACCESSORY[/b]

[b][Accessory - Basic Info][/b]
- Accessories can be Level Up.
- Accessories have Skill Damage Up options (e.g. [Haru's Sun Revolve] Total Damage +[5%])

> (Main Maze) Evolving Habitation <Boss: Vista>

> Team [2]: Max 4 Team Members
> Team [3]: Max 4 Team Members
> Sub Parties (Hall of Flames / Scarlet Madness / Howling Fang) → Defeat Flemma / Relfenne / Gale to gain Buffs for Entire Teams & gain Debuffs to weaken Vista

There comes a day each September when you wake up and know the summer is over and fall has arrived. 
The slant of the sun looks different and something is in the air–a coolness, a hint of frosty mornings to follow.
It’s the nature of the world. One thing remains, and one gone. Goodbye August and Hello September.

Please look forward to our Upcoming September Update.
Thank you so much!

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/86ee52367c9f5edb5bbf78095ba0b87e3d93b4e8.png[/img]

[b]◆ 2023 July Update Preview[/b]

[b]☞ July Second Update (on July 20th)[/b]

[b]1. EPISODE 2 (ACT 1 / ACT 2)[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/303d055c6d31ab37fffec47bfff9d3213ddb2d96.png[/img]

★ Episode 2 is subtitled "Nowhere to Hide".

[i][b]Haven Island, a huge island in the East Cloudream.
It was once known as Paradise Island... But now there is no light and no human footprint at all. Heaven? That was a long time ago.
Yes... this is where the Second Story is about to begin; the island with mysterious sounds... and screams.[/b][/i]

That's where the SoulWorkers struggle to thwart Vista's demonic plan!


★ Episode 2 [Act 1 / Act 2] Update: July 20th, 2023
★ Episode 2 [Act 3] Update: August 3rd, 2023


[b]1-1. [NEW MAZE] MUTED HAVEN[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/0b5b1bdd5256be34c737665a342df8c6b7f3a7aa.png[/img]

▶ Recommended: Lv. 79 or Higher

[i][b]Highly advanced science is nothing short of magic...
and the precarious earth will eventually die and disappear.
You mortal beings are useless, and time is worthless.
Every life and hope will turn to dust and ashes...
Now Perish.[/b][/i]


Heitz and Martin have finally found the location where Vista is believed to be located. No time to hesitate. They immediately called SoulWorkers.

Once known as Paradise Island, Haven Island was rich in trade with Arcadia Realm. But now there is no light and no human footprint. And Heitz told SoulWorkers it's time to begin a manhunt for Vista... right here.

SoulWorkers have finally arrived in Haven Island. A... paradise? The island is completely in ruins.
All of a sudden, the Vacuum Junk appears and attacks SoulWorkers. Something... Something's not right... They realize that bodies are Heavier than usual.

Heitz constantly coughs on her way to the lab. Eventually, she can't stand the pain and falls down.
SoulWorkers decide to leave Haven Island immediately and return to Arcadia Realm... to save her.
After arriving, they visit Sedurin to ask why Heitz is sick.

Sedurin has asked SoulWorkers to go back to Haven Island with her Signal Detector.
They hope this device finds out a certain signal that made Heitz sick and fall.


[b]1-2. [NEW MAZE] CHAMBER ASTRAY[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/7602f27c5d6507fe58d8e24c36a8636e2eefda7c.png[/img]

▶ Recommended: Lv. 80 or Higher

[i][b]Ah yes. Science... It shall fulfill my dream, my ambition... my everything.
Yes, yes! Eat every single life and take all the souls in this pathetic world!
YOU... Make Me Complete![/b][/i]


Heitz was restored to health without any further problems. And SoulWorkers killed all the enemies at the laboratory entrance.
Now's the time for them to enter the lab of Vista. Heitz also called Thomas to the front of the laboratory, and she told him to go into the lab with the SoulWorkers...

No one had a map of the lab. But this place was too big and wide. SoulWorkers and Thomas were afraid they'd miss Vista here...
They were at a loss for how to find their destination. Just then, a mysterious girl appeared in front of them. The girl told them where to go to meet Vista.
And... she suddenly disappeared in a flash.


[b]1-3. [QUEST] STORY FOR EACH CHARACTER[/b]

1. Haru Estia

Thomas tried to go to Haven Island to disrupt Vista's experiment. But Haru killed Vista's test subjects a step ahead of Thomas to stop and calm him down.


2. Erwin Arclight

Erwin found Rona looked very tired than usual. He asked Rona if she was okay. Then, she told him that it was because the Coffee Truck failed to arrive due to the attack of Vacuum Junk. Rona also said that C-ration Coffee cannot be defined as coffee. Now, Erwin headed to Haven Island... to find authentic regular coffee.


3. Lily Bloommerchen

A boy didn't give up and kept trying to go to the island to find his parents. Lily promised the boy that she would find his parents instead. Then she headed to Haven Island.


4. Jin Seipatsu

Jin heard there was a unit out of touch on the way back from operations on Haven Island. So, he entered the island to search for them.


5. Stella Unibell

Stella heard a rumor from Rona that a ghost was coming out of Haven Island. She said she would deal with everything related to the ghost and headed for the island.


6. Iris Yuma

Iris heard that Michelle, her mother, suddenly became unconscious with the flu. Sedurin said it could be a Monopuhl Leave Addiction, not the flu. And Rona told Iris about the conspiracy of Congress about Monopuhl Leaves. But the problem was that the existing drugs administered to Michelle... did not work at all. Iris headed to Haven Island to find relevant data.


7. Chii Aruel

Chii tried to find the source of the dog odor coming from somewhere. However, the smell came from various objects. She guessed that this smell may have come from Haven Island.


8. Ephnel

A soldier told Ephnel about his friend who went missing during an operation. He asked her to search the island. Then Ephnel told the soldier she would do the job for 1,000,000 Zenny, and he accepted it.


9. Lee Nabi

Nabi heard rumors from Heitz and Rona that ghosts appear on Haven Island. So, Nabi set off to the island to confirm the truth.


10. Dhana Opini

Dhana wanted to go to Haven Island and find traces of Vista. Heitz accepted her request.

notes.title: [Notice] 2023 May Update Preview
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/86ee52367c9f5edb5bbf78095ba0b87e3d93b4e8.png[/img]

[b]◆ 2023 May Update Preview[/b]

[b]☞ May First Update (on May 4th)[/b]

[b]1. Let’s Celebrate - EN Server 2ND ANNIVERSARY[/b]

- New Event Maze + New Mini Game Event

[b]▶ New Event Maze - Melodious Aurora[/b]
- Encounter Screeching Gruton and Test Your Limits!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/93a8da7704f7ba2359a0c1bf67f492af1995bb31.png[/img]

- Try to Defeat as many as Screeching Grutons within the Time Limit → The more Grutons you defeat → The more you can obtain rewards!


[b]▶ New Mini Game Event – Dance ~ Dance ~ Feel the Beat![/b]
- Enter Arrow buttons (quickly and accurately) within the time limit → Get Rewards!
- The more successful you are → The more buttons you need to press.


[b]2. Receive All Rewards Button for Achievement Reward / Progress Reward[/b]

- [Receive All] Button will be added to Achievement / Progression
> Enable to claim all rewards that you have finished and achieved.


[b]☞ May Second Update (on May 18th)[/b]

[b]1. LEAGUE UNITE – Main Character + Account Basis[/b]

[b]▶ PURPOSE[/b]
- Current Situation: Each Character → Each Different League

- Common Problems: 
> Users begin to level up New Character → No League → Hard to level up / ask for help
> All leagues have a Limited Number of members who can join. → Not Possible to let New Characters join the League

- How to Solve / Change
> Current: Join League → Each Character Basis
> After Update: Join League → Account Basis (+Main Character's League)


[b]▶ RECAP[/b]
- After Update → Account Basis + Main Character's League
> Your Main Character's League: Remain / Stay
> Your Other Characters' Leagues: Auto-Quit


[b]▶ CHANGES[/b]
- League Member Number Limit → Account Basis
- Enable to check Each Member's [Main Character].
- League Login Check: Once a Day (Account Basis)
- League Booster → Account Basis
- League News / Logbook: Written as the [Main Character] of Each Member
- [i][u][b][★★★Please Note★★★][/b][/u][/i] No Main Character Yet? → Not Possible to Join / Create League
- [i][u][b][★★★Please Note★★★][/b][/u][/i] After joining the League → Not Possible to Delete Main Character


[b]★★★ MORE ABOUT [LEAGUE UNITE] UPDATE ★★★[/b]

[i][u][b](PLEASE READ THE FOLLOWING CAREFULLY before May 18th Update.)[/b][/u][/i]

[b]▶ LEAGUE MASTER[/b]

[b]1. If Your Main Character = League Master[/b]
- League Master Grade will Remain.
- Your Other Characters → Auto-Join Your League

[b]2. Your Character is the League Master → But if this character is Not your Main Character[/b]
- This League Master Character is Not your Main Character → Auto-Quit the League
- This League's [Vice Master] Character → Become the League Master
> [i][u][b][★★★Please Note★★★][/b][/u][/i] But!! If this [Vice Master] Character is also Not a Main Character? → Not Possible to be the League Master → The League will be DELETED!!


[b]▶ LEAGUE DELETION[/b]

[b]1. About League Deletion[/b]
- [i][u][b][★★★Please Note★★★][/b][/u][/i] League Deletion → Every Single Infomation of the League will be Lost and Gone.
- Deleted League → 'League Emblem Change' item can Not be Returned or Recovered or Restored.
- League Deleted by League Unite Update → League NAME can be used AGAIN after May 18th Update.

[b]2. About League Store (When League Deletion)[/b]
- League Deleted by League Unite Update → League Store's Each Item:
> [i][u][b][★★★Please Note★★★][/b][/u][/i] Each Item will be returned to the [Last Character] who put the item in the League Store
> How to Return: via H.E.M.S (Account Basis)

- If that [Last Character] is Deleted → the item will be sent to H.E.M.S. (Account Basis)

- Each Item can be received through H.E.M.S within One Year.
>[i][u][b] [★★★Please Note★★★][/b][/u][/i] If you don't receive it within 1 year → Not Possible to Return or Recover or Restore.


[b]▶ PARTICULAR SITUATIONS (AFTER LEAGUE UNITE UPDATE)[/b]

- Auto-Quit League by League Unite Update → Enable to Join the League after May 18th Update without any penalty

- After League Unite Update (May 18th Update) → Join League → Leave → Penalty (Account Basis): Can't join another League right away

- Ongoing League Raid will be ENDED / CLOSED → After League Unite Update (May 18th Update) → Rewards will be provided.

[b]▶ MORE INFORMATION[/b]

- League UI design will be improved.

- Not joined any League yet → Press League button → New Pop-up: Create League / League List
> New Pop-up: Create League / League List → Can also be activated through NPC 'Seres'
> This function can ONLY be used in Districts.


Please look forward to our Upcoming May Update.
Take a walk. Smell a flower. Catch some sun. Play SoulWorker.
But whatever you do, have a Happy May Day!
Thank you so much!

※ The update in detail may be altered due to unprecedented internal issues.

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/55ee63a25754ab97c8cf32449b1c9b0f94cb060c.png[/img]

Dear SoulWorkers,
This is Kyeong-Bae, Park of Superany Studio in Lion Games.

Finally, we can get rid of our thick, woolen winter wear and boring sweaters.
Happy Spring Day to you all!

And today, I want to talk about the Second Update of this Month (March 23rd, 2023).



[b]1. NEW COLLABORATION[/b]
I just attached ONLY ONE mysterious picture on [Notice] 2023 March Update Preview.
But, the first comment of the update preview was… [The Collab is with Guilty Gear]~!

OMG! Yes, you guys are Correct!
New Collaboration will be SoulWorker X GUILTY GEAR -STRIVE- (Arc System Works)!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/1a3ba42910805ad5879b44753177a41ab40bb54c.png[/img]


[Synopsis]
It happened without any sign or warning... 
Alternate Vacuum appeared in District 6 with Unprecedented Energy.

The person who came out of the Vacuum called herself... Jack-O' Valentine.
And Jack-O', A Wanderer from Another World, joined forces with SoulWorkers to find a way back to Her World.


[b]2. UPDATE PLAN: COLLABORATION[/b]
SoulWorker X GUILTY GEAR -STRIVE- Update will be divided into Two Parts.

▶ FIRST UPDATE: March 23rd Update
▶ SECOND UPDATE: April 6th Update

I am going to tell you about FIRST UPDATE of SoulWorker X GUILTY GEAR -STRIVE- today.

★ Costume for Female Characters

[SOUL MATE]
THREE NEW SOUL MATES (SoulWorker X GUILTY GEAR -STRIVE-) will be updated!

> Ramlethal Valentine (Rank S)
> Ky Kiske (Rank A)

[AKASHIC RECORD]

There will be Two Special Events for New & Existed SoulWorkers!

> Enable to try again and again until you clear the stage.
> No FP Consumption

> ※ A player is allowed to clear 1 Stage per Day.

notes.title: [Producer’s Comment] About Costumes and Brooches
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/55ee63a25754ab97c8cf32449b1c9b0f94cb060c.png[/img]

Dear SoulWorkers,

This is Kyeong-Bae, Park of Superany Studio in Lion Games.

How are You? Yes, I heard and read every single voice of yours through our Operation Team.
So, I guess this is the right time to explain the reason for the Changes in Costume and Brooch.

[b]1. WHY I NEED TO CHANGE (Can be Traded → Possession)[/b]

First of all, Costumes / Brooches → [Possession] state
▶ I would like to inform you that this is just a [b]TEMPORARY[/b] measure!

Massive Chargeback of Cash Costumes and Brooches are the crucial reason of the change.
It negatively exceeded my studio's expectations.

However, Superany Studio and I hear and read all your voices through various communities.
While writing this to you, my studio is trying to find a solution.

[b]I PROMISE YOU![/b]
WHEN the prevention and solution are found, [Possession] will go back to [Can be Traded] again.

2. MISTAKE (Crafted Brooches → Possession)
There was a mistake in Crafted Brooches (Brooch Transmitter Select Option / NPC ‘EO’) were also changed to the [Possession] state.
But, it was not possible to fix through simple data modification as several other side effects were expected at the time.

As it was announced in [Notice] 230202 Update Note Preview, this issue will be properly fixed in February 16th Update.

▶ Crafted Brooches from Brooch Transmitter Select Option / NPC ‘EO’ → Can be Traded

I will let you know more detailed information about this modification through ‘[Notice] 230216 Update Note Preview’.

No doubt, it’s my mistake. I wanted to say I’m terribly sorry to you all.

Superany Studio and I, Kyeong-Bae, Park, will consider and develop contents you can love.
ALWAYS, Your Support means the world, and I can’t thank you enough.
AGAIN, I am so delighted YOU are with us!

Thank YOU so much.

[b]Hello! This is an announcement from SoulWorker.

[b]---------------------------------------------◆ UPDATE ◆---------------------------------------------[/b]

[b]▶ NEW SYSTEM – AKASHIC RECORD [ACCOUNT BASIS][/b]

[i][u][b][WARNING][/b][/u][/i] Cumulated EXP (by EXP Fuse) for Engrave → EXP will be completely LOST.
> To prevent this, please move all your Equipped Akashic Records to the Inventory in advance (Before Update).

1. Akashic Record Register means:
> Akashic Record (Inventory) → Click to USE → that Akashic Record goes to (Akashic) Menu
> [i][b][u](After Update)[/u][/b][/i] All your characters (Account) will share the state of Akashic Record Register.

[i][u][b][e.g.][/b][/u][/i] 'Vista' Akashic Record (Inventory) → Click to USE → 'Vista' Akashic Record goes to (Akashic) Menu
★ All your characters (Account) will be able to use 'Vista' Akashic Record on (Akashic) Menu.

- HOWEVER, Akashic Record Equip → It is saved for Each Character in the same way as before.


2. Akashic Record Remove means: 
> Akashic Record (Akashic Menu) → Click to REMOVE → that Akashic Record returns to (Inventory)

[Fusion Point Info]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/4375b6f2559ace99aa40468515861d9362d08ac4.png[/img]

3) Fusion Point: 
> 100pt → Enable to do Mystic Fusion
> Fusion Point is not accumulated. 100pt can only be reached through Material Akashic Records.

4) Fusion Point 100pt → Mystic Fusion → Get 'Mystic Grade' Akashic Record (100%)


3. New Menu – Mystic (Encyclopedia Akashic Record)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/1f190678faf2f4316c20a351c822dec7ea4232e5.png[/img]

[b]▶ NEW AKASHIC RECORD - Ethereal Curator Lucy[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/2dbda4dd0eeadd9c4dd0f4d2fcf408417eaf8494.png[/img]


- Ethereal Curator Lucy ('Mystic Grade' Akashic Record ) will be updated.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/2a2017e4e487eaf17b0995ab0366ceeb60c6f372.png[/img]

notes.title: [Notice] 221117 Update Note Preview
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/86ee52367c9f5edb5bbf78095ba0b87e3d93b4e8.png[/img]


[b]Hello! This is an announcement from SoulWorker.
Here is the Update and Event News for November 17, 2022.[/b]

[b]---------------------------------------------◆ UPDATE ◆---------------------------------------------[/b]

[b]▶ NEW RAID - Parallel Metronome [NORMAL / HARD][/b]

- New Raid "Parallel Metronome" [NORMAL / HARD] will be updated.
> [NORMAL] Mode: Can challenge as Solo (1 Player)
> [HARD] Mode: Can challenge as Solo or Party (1 ~ 4 Players)
- "Parallel Metronome" related Achievements will also be added.

[b][ ENTRY REQUIREMENT ][/b]
- Above Lv. 79 can enter.

[b][ More About Parallel Metronome ] [/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/34505d7fd19394b38a5244f8279b1ba8e97b9b44.png[/img]

[b]1. HOW TO ENTER[/b]
- Must ACCEPT the Quest [Parallel Keeper] from NPC ‘Eo’ in Arcadia Realm
> Then, Parallel Metronome will be unlocked and activated.
> No need to receive or accept [Parallel Keeper] Quest again.

-  Enable to enter Parallel Metronome through NPC [Rona] in Arcadia Realm

[b]2. VALID ENTRY[/b]
* FP Consumption per Entry: FP 20
- Parallel Metronome doesn't have any Entry Limit. (e.g. If a player has enough FP, No limit to enter the raid.)
- However, Parallel Metronome has a "Valid Entry" limit.

- Valid Entry: The actual number that a player can obtain Drop Items if a player clears the raid.
> Fail to clear the Raid within Valid Entry Limit → No Reward and Lose 1 chance of Valid Entry Limit
> Leaving in the middle of the Raid → No Reward and Lose 1 chance of Valid Entry Limit

- The number of valid entries (for NORMAL / HARD) is 9 per week and will be added 2 times when Soul "PLUS" is activated.
- When a player enters the raid → the Valid Entry Limit will be immediately deducted.
- No Valid Entry Left means: No Drop or Reward Items can be obtained.
- Valid Entry Limit will be "Reset Mondays at 1 AM (GMT)".
* Not possible to enter with Force state.

[b]3. FURTHER INFO[/b]
- Total Phase: 2
- All Players Dead and No one have 'Respawn': Not possible to obtain rewards.

- Respawn Limit:
> Free Respawn - [3] +2 (PLUS)
> Respawn (with Items) - [3]
> Cash Respawn - [Unlimited]
- Not possible to use ACTIVE Akashic Record

- New Crafting Materials will be added.
- New Equipment will be added.

[b]3-1. REWARDS – RAID CLEAR[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/8d15413a3c90e72a037d83277d7ee58b7c229ddc.png[/img]

3-2. DROP ITEM LISTS
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/718056e2c35aba449420fd1a602e12ed5e92e289.png[/img]

[b][ Daily / Weekly Quest - Parallel Metronome ][/b]

- Daily Mission < Unstoppable Today >
> (Currently) Defeat Boss of [Broken Savior] or [Tragic Fairy] x1 with Any Difficulty
> (After Update) Defeat Boss of [Broken Savior] or [Tragic Fairy] or [Parallel Metronome] x1 with Any Difficulty

- Weekly Mission < [Maniac/Repeat] Research Data Collection >
> Speak to [Worker Support Device: Merchants' Union] in [Arcadia Realm] → [Quest] tab → 'Sedurin's Mission Receiver' (100,000 Zenny)
> Sedurin's Mission Receiver: Can purchase Once a Week


[b]▶ NEW EQUIPMENT SLOT – < Spirit >[/b]

[b][ Basic Info ][/b]
- New Equipment Slot 'Spirit' will be updated.
- Spirit: Can gain EXP and enable to LEVEL UP
- Spirit Slot Unlock Quest: Can receive the quest from NPC 'Eo' in Arcadia Realm
- Spirit Upgrade / Option Change: NPC 'Sedurin' in Arcadia Realm
- Spirit Level UP → Certain Level is reached → Spirit Mastery Option (with New Stats) UNLOCKED

[b][ More About ‘Spirit’ ][/b]
[b]1. Equipment Upgrade (Level Up)[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/54c4f5b117cfa53001608ca83aba1598737e0f71.png[/img]


- Upgrade Material: Can check in [Material Item Lists] on the right
- Material Items: Can register in up to 8 slots per time.
- Register Material Items: Can check the change of Level gauge / Option value
- EXP for Spirit: Enable to obtain after Maze Clear.

< EXP for Spirit – Maze Clear >
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/c220a3086d4012f8a0edc0fb575c2830860e7cf9.png[/img]
* To obtain EXP for Spirit: Must equip Spirit in the Maze to gain Spirit EXP.
* Daydream Maze: Not Possible to Obtain any EXP for Spirit.

[b]2. Option Change[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/ee76047964319f545415fb185b9a5256be5e5c2a.png[/img]

※ Same Options will not be appeared and be listed. (Same Options - Not Possible to Attach)

[b]3. Mastery Options[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/a4acb6620c0a220ecb7b99b487272dc1a66e7974.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/4dc971740c87d9d4d0615a87397e939364b26444.png[/img]

[b]<Spirit Option Change Lists>[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/e39bde6ebe02bb8bdb055a2458fe55cd75177410.png[/img]

[b]< Spirit Crafting - Parallel Metronome >[/b]

> Which NPC: NPC [Sedurin]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/7b49934bd1c3f7e32ee5b3fbd14aab1ea5774724.png[/img]

[b]< Dismantle Spirit - Parallel Metronome >[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/f292100e54c04dc9687d8ce954f0db530c9cf252.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/df01b2b2c571a6c8a3bac8047c12ff0db9b50159.png[/img]

[b]< Option Change - Parallel Metronome: Material Item / Ether / Zenny >[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/f4f1872d656ebbb85f843a872eddb21031246d70.png[/img]

[b]< Parallel Metronome – Items that Can Be Traded >[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/4882360bc764297a05d29934fe3c68473489ac29.png[/img]

[b]▶ IMPROVEMENT – Beginner / Returnee Function[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/b513dc7b033d5e27f200aa1cf1339b234209b8a8.png[/img]

[b]1. Dedicated Mark for Beginner / Returnee[/b]
- For Beginner / Returnee: Dedicated Mark (Beginner / Returnee) is displayed instead of Rank Mark.
- Team Play with Beginner / Returnee:
> (Loading Page) Beginner / Returnee Mark will be displayed during Team and Force stats.
- Auto Team Matching:
> If there is Beginner / Returnee, Beginner / Returnee Mark will be displayed to that Beginner / Returnee.
- Look for Team / Force:
(Check Team / Force Members) If there is Beginner / Returnee, Beginner / Returnee Mark will be displayed to that Beginner / Returnee.

- Who are the Beginner / Returnee?
* Beginner: Create an Account → Access to our game for the first time (Beginner Mark will last for 20 days)
* Returnee: Access to SoulWorker → No Access More than 30 days → Access to SoulWorker again (Returnee Mark will last for 20 days)

[b]2. IMPROVED - Attendance Check for Beginner / Returnee[/b]
- Enable to Earn Rewards for 10 DAYS
> Duration of Beginner / Returnee: 20 days
> Even if Beginner / Returnee can't access our game for a day or two, Enable to get all the rewards if access to the game for 10 days out of 20 days.

[b][ Attendance Reward for Beginner ONLY ][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/86ef168b120b404e1318f4cd3e79f4199c7eaf99.png[/img]

[b][ Attendance Reward for Returnee ONLY ][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/1eff64b2caaaa0b90882d6acdd847d2465a6cc98.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/10cedc27cbca60a4ab0c57ceb28555557886412d.png[/img]

[b]3. Additional Drop Material Items for Beginner / Returnee  (Solo / Team Play)[/b]
- Beginner / Returnee can obtain additional rewards (Maze dropped Materials) in certain Mazes (Solo / Team stats).
- Team with Beginner / Returnee: Additional Rewards will be provided to ALL TEAM MEMBERS.
> To obtain Additional Rewards: Beginner / Returnee / Rest of Team Members must have 'Valid Entry'.
> If additional rewards can be obtained → it is displayed as an icon.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/79e96e15128fba73a3497579f2d4e6ead9195df7.png[/img]


[b]---------------------------------------------◆ EVENT ◆---------------------------------------------[/b]

[b]▶ NEW EVENT BEGINS[/b]

[b]1. GRUTON NESTING DOLL EVENT[/b]
- Event Period: November 17th Update ~ December 22nd Update

- Event Recap
> Clear Daily Mission → Can obtain Gruton Nesting Doll

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/86ee52367c9f5edb5bbf78095ba0b87e3d93b4e8.png[/img]

[b]◆ 2022 November Update Preview[/b]

[b]☞ November First Update[/b]

▶ Character Skill Balance Patch
- Lv. 72 Skill efficiency will be improved.
- Skill Balance Patch → For Some of Characters

[ Lv. 72 Skill Improvement ]
- Lv. 72 Skill Motion (Ready / Finish Motion) is too long → This issue will be improved.
- (For Erwin / Nabi) Enable to use other skill combos immediately through Immediate Attack or Immediate Landing.

< Lily Bloommerchen >
- Super Armor Break UP for Some Skills

< Stella Unibell >
- Stella's SG will be 200. (As SG will be 200 → Passive will also be changed.)
- Damage UP / Super Armor Break UP for Some Skills

< Jin Seipatsu >
- Super Armor Break UP for Some Skills

- 'Counter Stream' Skill: 
> (After Update) It will be affected by Attack Speed.
> Aftercast Delay will be removed during an attack.
> Counter Attack Success → SG Recovery Buff will be added.

- 'Final Fist' Skill:
> Attack Range will be improved.

< Ephnel >
- New Buff will be added to enhance the stability of some of the channelling skills.
- Some Channelling Skills: Damage and Skill Structures will be changed.

< Lee Nabi >
- SG and Cooldown of Some Skills will be (slightly) reduced.


[b]▶ New Akashic Record[/b]
- New Akashic Record [★5 Vista] / [★4 Nya] will be updated.
- Akashic Record [RATE UP] Transmission Chance will be added.
> For: [★5 Vista] / [★4 Nya]

> [+0] Nya

> [+2] Musician of the Autumn Sky Nya

- Melody to Cheer Up (Based on Normal +2)
> When Equipped: (Every 50 sec) Recover HP [3%] every [1sec] for [10sec] & More DMG to Boss / Named +[5%] for [50sec]

- Melody to Cheer Up (Based on Hidden +2)
> When Equipped: (Every 50 sec) Recover HP [3%] every [1sec] for [10sec] & More DMG to Boss / Named +[7%] for [50sec]


[b][ New Akashic Record: ★5 Vista ][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/2c0dc23f85e3d48f98d85f97a6c47ca2007f6e39.png[/img]
< ★5 Vista - Normal >

< ★5 Vista Akashic Record – Explosion Effect >

Further Info
- ★Vista is [Conditional Passive] Akashic Record.
> [+0] Vista
> [+1] Mad Scientist Vista
> [+2] Unprecedented Third Star Vista

- Handle with Care (Based on Normal +2)
> Successful Critical Hits: Explosions Ahead and Damage Enemies & [Transition State] Buff is provided to oneself.
> [Transition State] Buff: Current HP -[15%] / Armor Break +[3%] and Damage +[1800] for [45sec] (Cooldown: 40sec)

- Handle with Care (Based on Hidden +2)
> Successful Critical Hits: Explosions Ahead and Damage Enemies & [Transition State] Buff is provided to oneself.
> [Transition State] Buff: Current HP -[15%] / Armor Break +[4%] and Damage +[2000] for [45sec] (Cooldown: 40sec)


[b]☞ November Second Update[/b]

[b]▶IMPROVEMENT – Beginner / Returnee Function[/b]
- New Attendance Check will be added for Beginners and Returnees.

- For Beginner / Returnee: Dedicated Mark (Beginner / Returnee) is displayed instead of Rank Mark.
> Beginner / Returnee Mark will be displayed during Team and Force stats.

- Beginner / Returnee can obtain additional rewards (Maze dropped Materials) in certain Mazes (Solo / Team stats).
- Team with Beginner / Returnee: Additional Rewards will be provided to ALL TEAM MEMBERS.
> To obtain Additional Rewards: Beginner / Returnee / Rest of Team Members must have 'Valid Entry'.
> If additional rewards can be obtained → it is displayed as an icon.

[b]▶ NEW RAID - Parallel Metronome[/b]
- New Raid ‘Parallel Metronome’ will be updated. 
> [NORMAL] Difficulty: Can play Solo
> [HARD] Difficulty: Can play as Solo and Team (1 ~ 4 Players)

- New Equipment Item can ONLY be obtained in Parallel Metronome.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/c97cb41484155afc81927a362fa9c51337981260.png[/img]

▶ NEW EQUIPMENT SLOT - Spirit
- New Equipment Slot 'Spirit' will be updated.
- There will be a New Equipment Slot UI.
> 'Spirit' type Equipment can only be equipped.
> This new UI can be unlocked by a certain Quest.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/df1452ed96f51822b8d6976e3cf1f2584fce22eb.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/6a671f10af8894cc169cc754fbd26cf71f5030db.png[/img]



☞ About December Update
- The 10th Playable Character: Dhana Opini
- New Soul Mate: Dhana / Shurii


Please look forward to our Upcoming November Update.
Wishing you a November filled with good friends, good food, good games (SoulWorker) and good times.
Thank you so much!

※ The update in detail may be altered due to unprecedented internal issues.

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/86ee52367c9f5edb5bbf78095ba0b87e3d93b4e8.png[/img]


[b]Hello! This is an announcement from SoulWorker.
Here is the Update and Event News for October 20, 2022.[/b]

[b]---------------------------------------------◆ UPDATE ◆---------------------------------------------[/b]

[b]▶ NEW SYSTEM – Soul Mate [ DISPATCH ][/b]

[b][BASIC INFO][/b]
- Soul Mate [Dispatch] system will be updated.
- Can find at Game Menu → [Soul Mate Dispatch]
- Hotkey Settings: Click 'Esc' button → Settings → Hotkeys → UI → Soul Mate Dispatch

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/4a3af2af9541592c90379446b11a01750b62c6f1.png[/img]

- Enable to check Soul Mate's Exploration Value / Type (e.g. Human / Flying / Psychic / and so on) / Various other information.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/4ec9d611a8b463e532fbaf3e3732d5d3f91e13d2.png[/img]

[b][More About Soul Mate DISPATCH][/b]

[b]1. Exploration Value[/b]
- Exploration Value: Minimum Numerical Value (Soul Mate) required by each area.
- Each Soul Mate has a different Exploration Value.
> Based on Soul Mate's Rank and Level

[b]2. Required Types[/b]
- (After Update) Soul Mates will have Certain Types for Dispatch system.
> Multiple-type
> Human-type
> Animal-type
> Flying-type
> Agile-type
> Psychic-type
> Support-type
> Fusion-type
- Each Soul Mate will have Two types.
- Exploration Value of Soul Mate will change according to Rank (Birth Rank / Current Rank).

[b]3. Soul Mate DISPATCH (Areas of Exploration)[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/a2aa52cb24e0fceb00063c22c3237e50b1bac530.png[/img]

- (Areas of Exploration) Select an Area → (Dispatch Team Info) Choose Your Soul Mates → Click [START] → Dispatch Begins!

- [Auto Select] Button:
> Can find at 'Dispatch Team Info'
> Click this button → Soul Mates that meet the conditions are automatically selected.

- Dispatch Complete → Can obtain various rewards.
- To use the Dispatch system, a player must have one Soul Mate at least.
- Areas of Exploration: Can check details of Areas that can be explored.
- Bonus Rewards can be obtained in addition to the Basic Rewards if all the detailed conditions (Exploration Point / Required Types / Time / and so on) required by the dispatch area are satisfied.

※ Exploration Point: Basic Rewards will be added by the Excess Rate.
> Basic Rewards: EXP for Soul Mate / BP / Zenny / Ether

[b]4. Dispatch Team Info[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/90c2fa720a755ba44b21a110955680712cb1c63f.png[/img]

- Dispatch Team Info: Enable to organize Soul Mate Team for Dispatch conveniently.
- Click [ + ] button → "Your Soul Mate Lists" will appear → Can choose Soul Mates → Click OK or CANCEL

[b]5. Dispatch START[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/57c8ef443399752829b20dee77e33f9de4acb52f.png[/img]

- Click [START] button to Start Dispatch.

- Dispatch Time:
> If you are playing SoulWorker → Dispatch Time will be reduced Twice as Fast. [Login Boost (Time Flies) is Applied!]
> If you are NOT playing SoulWorker → Dispatch Time will be reduced at the same rate as Real Time.

- Rewards can be obtained at the end of the Dispatch Time.
- The Area where the reward is obtained → Can be dispatched again at 01:00 (GMT) the Next Day.


[b]▶ NEW SOUL MATES[/b]

- New Soul Mates [Miriam] / [Seres] will be updated.
> Rank S: Miriam
> Rank A: Seres

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/e79369c6ee1794e58c0bc769ff78ca9a5b70e24d.png[/img]

1) LEVEL 1 / ★1

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/79505ac71d9ca9a7929bc25c366ee8484a9c9054.png[/img]

2) LEVEL 30 / ★1

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/c4c2ae4fdc9e7650d28a5aad61c6926f1c36e472.png[/img]

[b]---------------------------------------------◆ EVENT ◆---------------------------------------------[/b]

[b]▶ NEW EVENT BEGINS – MOONLIGHT EVENT[/b]

* Event Period: October 20th Update ~ November 24th Update
* Event Recap:

[b][Moonlight Crafting][/b]
1) [Warp Orb] Moonlight Party:
> Can purchase at Gruton Coin Shop (Price: Gruton Coin 30)
> Can purchase Twice a day.

2) Use '[Warp Orb] Moonlight Party' to enter Moonlight Party event maze.

3) How to Obtain [EV] 2022 Halloween Candy Basket & [EV] 2022 Halloween Costume Coin:
> Clear Moonlight Party event maze
> Complete Daily Missions

[h3][i]※ [PLEASE NOTE] Daily Mission Rewards show only 3 rewards. However, you can obtain 4 rewards when you complete a mission. (Nothing to worry about!)[/i][/h3]

4) [EV] 2022 Halloween Candy Basket & [EV] 2022 Halloween Costume Coin: Can craft various items and costumes!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/86ee52367c9f5edb5bbf78095ba0b87e3d93b4e8.png[/img]


[b]Hello! This is an announcement from SoulWorker.
Here is the Update and Event News for October 6, 2022.[/b]

[b]---------------------------------------------◆ UPDATE ◆---------------------------------------------[/b]

[b]▶ RAID – TRAGIC FAIRY [MANIAC][/b]
- Tragic Fairy [MANIAC] will be updated.
- [MANIAC] Mode: Can challenge as Solo or Party (1 ~ 4 Players)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/89a57640ec574eecb44a0a610de0c310a21c43d0.png[/img]

[b][ ENTRY REQUIREMENT ][/b]
- Above Lv. 79 can enter.

[b][ VALID ENTRY ][/b]
* FP Consumption per Entry: FP 20
- Tragic Fairy [MANIAC] doesn't have any Entry Limit. (e.g. If a player has enough FP, No limit to enter the raid.)
- However, Tragic Fairy [MANIAC] has a "Valid Entry" limit.

- Valid Entry: The actual number that a player can obtain Drop Items if a player clears the raid.
> Fail to clear the Raid within Valid Entry Limit → No Reward and Lose 1 chance of Valid Entry Limit
> Leaving in the middle of the Raid → No Reward and Lose 1 chance of Valid Entry Limit

- The number of valid entries (for MANIAC) is 7 per week and will be added 2 times when Soul "PLUS" is activated.
- When a player enters the raid → the Valid Entry Limit will be immediately deducted.
- No Valid Entry Left means: No Drop or Reward Items can be obtained.
- Valid Entry Limit will be "Reset Mondays at 1 AM (GMT)".
- The number of valid entries (for MANIAC) will not be shared with valid entries (for NORMAL / HARD).
* Not possible to enter with Force status.

[b][ MORE ABOUT TRAGIC FAIRY: MANIAC ][/b]
- Total Phase: 2
> Ferdelance [Hard] Mode / Phase 2 = Ferdelance [MANIAC] Mode / Phase 1
> Ferdelance [MANIAC] Mode / Phase 2 → Players will encounter the most powerful version of Ferdelance.

notes.title: [Notice] In-game Known Issues
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/55ee63a25754ab97c8cf32449b1c9b0f94cb060c.png[/img]

Hello, this is an announcement from SoulWorker.
We have internally found an in-game issue related to Crafting Lists [Ranking] of Gruton Coin Shop after August (Season 2) Update.

Further details are as follows:

[b][Issue][/b]

- [Ranking] Crafting Lists (Gruton Coin Shop): '[EV] [Costume PKG] Ephnel's School Swimsuit' was registered instead of 'Ultimate Refined Stone (Possession)'.

[b][Fix][/b]

- Remove '[EV] [Costume PKG] Ephnel's School Swimsuit' from Gruton Coin Shop and Register 'Ultimate Refined Stone (Possession)' again. [b](Currently Fixed)[/b]

[b][Compensation][/b]

1. Users who [b]*Accessed the Game[/b] (August 18 Update ~ Before September 1 Update): 
> '[b][EV] School Swimsuit Costume PKG[/b]' will be provided.

2-1. Users who already Crafted '[EV] [Costume PKG] Ephnel's School Swimsuit' from [Ranking] of Gruton Coin Shop (August 18 Update ~ Before September 1 Update):
> '[EV] School Swimsuit Costume PKG' will [b]NOT[/b] be provided.

2-2. Users who already Crafted '[EV] [Costume PKG] Ephnel's School Swimsuit' from [Ranking] of Gruton Coin Shop (August 18 Update ~ Before September 1 Update): 
> '[b][Ranking] Gruton Medal[/b]' will be provided as much as you spent to craft '[EV] [Costume PKG] Ephnel's School Swimsuit'.

[b]* Game Access Record: Users who accessed the game → Select Character window → Accessed to Districts[/b]

[b]* Compensation H.E.M.S will expire on October 1st, 2022.[/b]

We sincerely apologize for this inconvenience, 
and SoulWorker will try to provide a better service for our users.

Thank you.

tags.bug: - [Ranking] Crafting Lists (Gruton Coin Shop): '[EV] [Costume PKG] Ephnel's School Swimsuit' was registered instead of 'Ultimate Refined Stone (Possession)'.

▶ NEW SYSTEM – Costume CLOSET/ Costume PRESET[/b]
- Costume CLOSET
> Costume Preview / Enable to Store Costumes in the CLOSET.

- Costume PRESET
> Costume PRESET: Can SAVE / LOAD your favorite costume settings in Districts.

[b][ CLOSET MENU ][/b]
* GAME MENU (Key: V) → Can find ‘CLOSET’ menu
* System Menu (Esc) → Settings → Hotkeys → UI → Closet (Assign a Shortcut Key)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/7dec2f09bf3bfca00e6d21014266b1b54c40c0ef.png[/img]

[b][ More About CLOSET ][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/ca270748a12c29e6f01317948fe64ae23cc09bc1.png[/img]

[b]① Closet Filter[/b]
* Filter – [Character]: Can select a Character (From Haru Estia to Lee Nabi) → Enable to check each character's Closet Lists.

* Filter – [Grade]: Can select Normal / Special / Premium / Premium S

* Filter – [Storage]: Can select All / Not Stored (in the Closet) / Stored (in the Closet)

* Filter – [Gesture]: Can select All / Possible / Not Possible
> Possible: One or more costume parts have a "Gesture"

* Filter – [Extraction]: Can select All / Possible / Not Possible
> Possible: One or more costume parts can be used "Extraction"

* Fileter – [Equalizer]: Can select All / Possible / Not Possible
> Possible: One or more costume parts have an "Equalizer"

[b]② Search / Reset[/b]
* Search (located at the top of the Closet UI): Can search by entering the Costume Set Name
* Reset (located on the right of Search): Search List can be initialized.

[b]③ Favorites[/b]
* Clicking on the "Star Shape" icon in the list → Activates "Favorites" and Exposes them first to the top.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/b160a419d9fcf0a7d39297594664c87e3b86725f.png[/img]

[b]④ Send to Closet[/b]
* Inventory → Costumes → Mouse Right Click → Send to Closet → Can store a costume in the Closet
* [PLEASE NOTE] "Bind on Equip" costumes will permanently CHANGE to the [Possession] state when clicked on the 'Send to Closet' menu.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/6e63f5a9088d301d10d438cb880d01e57e1927fb.png[/img]

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/e39416dc20bc556fe2a11fdf582cbfe870c7dbbf.png[/img]

[b]⑤ Back (Inventory)[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/e8837e4ab6c2ae3ba8049b1900d41ff9a3cc991d.png[/img]

[b]⑥ PREVIEW (Including Weapons)[/b]

* Character's Appearance Preview: Closet → Costumes in the Closet → Click the [Appearance] button in the lower right corner

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/309b1320a437abd3a7cb4f55ab5198e826c1e0ce.png[/img]

* Costumes that can be Dyed → Can Preview the dyed costume in the list.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/427f2d102d7b52c408c3c35dd8347dc7f475ef46.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/391b9accf577c662ad63136d5f78c327b6c9995a.png[/img]

[b]⑦ Pose Change (Equip a Weapon)[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/0afee2917117f7cc0e376de5db703bfe101be4e4.png[/img]

[b]⑧ Interaction[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/1237710c125bfdd3e543988785c96c342615ea3e.png[/img]

[ More About Closet PRESET ]

[b]① Preset Menu[/b]
* Closet → Preview window → Enable to find PREVIEW / PRESET menu
> Preview → Clothes-shaped Icon → Can check the detailed information of Costumes / Can release each costume icon by Mouse Left-Click or Right-Click

* Closet → Equip your favorite costume setting → Click Save Preset Button

tags.feature: ▶ NEW SYSTEM – Costume CLOSET/ Costume PRESET
- Costume CLOSET
> Costume Preview / Enable to Store Costumes in the CLOSET.
> Can store various costumes in the CLOSET.
- Costume PRESET
> Costume PRESET: Can SAVE / LOAD your favorite costume settings in Districts.
* GAME MENU (Key: V) → Can find ‘CLOSET’ menu
* System Menu (Esc) → Settings → Hotkeys → UI → Closet (Assign a Shortcut Key)
① Closet Filter
* Filter – [Character]: Can select a Character (From Haru Estia to Lee Nabi) → Enable to check each character's Closet Lists.
* Filter – [Grade]: Can select Normal / Special / Premium / Premium S
* Filter – [Storage]: Can select All / Not Stored (in the Closet) / Stored (in the Closet)
* Filter – [Gesture]: Can select All / Possible / Not Possible
> Possible: One or more costume parts have a "Gesture"
* Filter – [Extraction]: Can select All / Possible / Not Possible
> Possible: One or more costume parts can be used "Extraction"
* Fileter – [Equalizer]: Can select All / Possible / Not Possible
> Possible: One or more costume parts have an "Equalizer"
② Search / Reset
* Search (located at the top of the Closet UI): Can search by entering the Costume Set Name
* Reset (located on the right of Search): Search List can be initialized.
③ Favorites
* Clicking on the "Star Shape" icon in the list → Activates "Favorites" and Exposes them first to the top.
④ Send to Closet
* Inventory → Costumes → Mouse Right Click → Send to Closet → Can store a costume in the Closet
* When Storing in the Closet is complete → a Hanger icon appears on the left.
⑤ Back (Inventory)
* Closet → Costume you want to send to the Inventory again → Mouse Right Click → Back (Inventory)
* If you send 'all parts of a costume set' back to the Inventory → a Hanger icon will disappears on the left.
⑥ PREVIEW (Including Weapons)
* Closet → Mouse Left-Click on the costume icon (whether stored in the closet or not) → Preview window to view the Costume and Weapon Costumes.
* Character's Appearance Preview: Closet → Costumes in the Closet → Click the [Appearance] button in the lower right corner
* Costumes that can be Dyed → Can Preview the dyed costume in the list.
* Click "Reset" icon in PREVIEW → the Preview will be changed to the costume you are currently wearing.
⑦ Pose Change (Equip a Weapon)
* Preview window → Click Weapon-shaped Icon (UI) → Change to the posture holding a weapon.
⑧ Interaction
① Preset Menu
* Closet → Preview window → Enable to find PREVIEW / PRESET menu
> Preview → Clothes-shaped Icon → Can check the detailed information of Costumes / Can release each costume icon by Mouse Left-Click or Right-Click
② Save Preset
* Closet → Equip your favorite costume setting → Click Save Preset Button
* Saved Preset: Click the Preset Name at the top of the Preview window
> Game Menu ( V ) → Closet → Closet UI → PREVIEW → Can check your PRESET in a drop-down menu
> Drop-down Menu of PREVIEW: Can check [Preview] / [Preset Slot 1 ~ 20]
* A pop-up will show up [Another Preset already exists in THIS SLOT.] → When you try to save a different costume setting in the Preset Slot that has Another Preset setting
③ Preset Name Change
* Closet → PREVIEW → Choose one Preset Slot that you want to change a name → Click Name Change button
* Not Possible to Change the Name of “PREVIEW”
④ Apply Preset
* Choose Preset Slot that you want to apply → Click [Apply Preset] button
* [Please Note] Not Possible to Apply Preset when the Inventory (Costume) is full.
⑤ Costume Preset Slot Expansion
* Using "Costume Preset Slot Expansion" x1 → Enable to Unlock one Preset Slot.
* Costume Preset Slot Expansion: Can be purchased at Cash Shop.
▶ NEW SYSTEM – Character Quick Change
* Change Character (Quick Version): No need to go back to Select Character! Enable to change to your other character IMMEDIATELY!
* Can find 'Change Character (Quick Version)' via SYSTEM MENU (Esc button) → Change Character
* 'Change Character' can ONLY be used in Districts and District 6.
* Enable to check 'Maze Entry' Info of the Character that has accessed in the game today.
* Enable to check 'Maze Entry' Info of the Character that has accessed in the game today.
* PLUS-specific FP: Shows ONLY the Character that Accessing Now
* When you select a character you want to change → Can check DAILY CONTENTS / WEEKLY CONTENTS information
★ New Summer Event Maze – [Fireworks Festival] ★
- Character Level Restriction: At least Lv. 30
- The maze is divided into Festival Stalls Section / Quiz Section / Boss Fight.
- Festival Stalls Section: ‘Dodge’ or ‘Defeat’ enemies in street stalls and activate all 3 Fireworks.
- Quiz Section: Must guess the answer to the OX quiz.
- Boss Fight: Clear Festival Stalls / Quiz Section → Boss Fight
- [Event] Summer Night Fireworks Festival (QUEST): Can receive through NPC 'Toru' in Grace City / Character Level - At least Lv. 30
- EVENT ITEM: [EV] RED Lantern / [EV] BLUE Lantern
- [Warp Orb] Fireworks Festival:
* Enable to teleport to [Fireworks Festival] maze.
* Can purchase at Gruton Coin Shop (Price: Gruton Coin 30)
* Can purchase once a day per Account
* Character Level must be at least Lv.30
- [EV] RED Lantern / [EV] BLUE Lantern:
* Clear Fireworks Festival maze → Can obtain Red / Blue Lantern items.
* Gruton Coin Shop of ‘Event’ / ‘Event II’ tabs: Can be exchanged to useful items (Including Event Costume / Title).
* MIDNIGHT BEACHWEAR (Event Costume): Can be crafted with [EV] Blue Lantern at Gruton Coin Shop.

notes.title: [Notice] 2022 September Update Preview
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/86ee52367c9f5edb5bbf78095ba0b87e3d93b4e8.png[/img]


[b]☞ September First Update
[/b]
[b]▶ NEW SYSTEM – Costume CLOSET/ Costume PRESET[/b]
[Costume CLOSET]
- Costume Preview / Enable to Store Costumes in the CLOSET.
- Can store various costumes (Cash Shop Purchased Costumes / Costumes obtained through Events / and so on) in the CLOSET.
- Dyed Costumes: Can be stored in Each Color and Enable to check through PREVIEW of the Closet.

[Costume PRESET]
- Costume PRESET: Can SAVE / LOAD your favorite costume settings.
- How to Activate: Save Costumes in the PRESET SLOT → Load PRESET in [Districts] → Your Costume Preset will be ACTIVATED


[b]▶ NEW SYSTEM – Character Quick Change[/b]
- Change Character (Quick Version): No need to go back to Select Character! Enable to change to your other character IMMEDIATELY!
- Can find 'Change Character (Quick Version)' via SYSTEM MENU.
- Enable to check 'FP' / 'Maze Entry' Info of the Character that has accessed in the game today.


[b]▶ NEW EVENT – Fireworks Festival[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/8a618307f0b04fca287c7f3ecd20ee8f42eb1800.png[/img]
- New Event Maze: ‘Fireworks Festival’ will be updated.
- Speak to NPC 'Toru' in Grace City → Can receive the Event Quest: '[Event] Summer Night Fireworks Festival'


[b]☞ September Second Update[/b]

[b]▶ NEW RAID – Tragic Fairy [NORMAL / HARD][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/254a36cfaa6834d50690bc16fc6f144596815405.jpg[/img]
- New Raid: TRAGIC FAIRY will be updated.
- [NORMAL] Mode: Can challenge as Solo (1 Player)
- [HARD] Mode: Can challenge as Solo or Party (1 ~ 4 Players)
- New Weapon / New Gear / New Accessory will be updated.
- New Scenario will be added.
- Daily Mission 'Supercar with No Brakes' Quest Condition will be changed.

[b]▶ CHANGE – Violent Sun / Broken Savior Equipment (Slightly Easy to Craft and Upgrade)[/b]
- 'Picaresque' equipment: Craft / Upgrade will be slightly easier than before due to the update of New Weapon / Gear (Tragic Fairy Raid).
> Upgrade: 'Picaresque' Weapon / Gear will not be destroyed.
> Random Option Change of 'Picaresque' equipment: Basic Material items (that used for crafting the equipment) will be consumed for Random Option Change (No more ‘Energy Converter’).

- Pale Ashes Extend equipment will be added to Crafting List as Time Limited Item (e.g. Can be used for 28 days and then Auto-Deleted).
> Time Limited Pale Ashes equipment can be crafted by Each Character Every Month.


[b]☞ About October Update[/b]
- Speech Bubbles Customization System will be updated.
- Tragic Fairy [MANIAC] will be updated.
- New Soul Mate: Miriam / Seres
- Character Skill Balance Patch will be scheduled.
- New Akashic Record will be updated.


Please look forward to our Upcoming September Update.

There comes a day each September when you wake up and know the summer is over and fall has arrived. 
The slant of the sun looks different and something is in the air–a coolness, a hint of frosty mornings to follow.
It’s the nature of the world. One thing remains, and one gone. Goodbye August and Hello September.

Thank you so much!

※ The update in detail may be altered due to unprecedented internal issues.
