notes.title: [Notice] 220818 Update Note Preview - SEASON 2 (REVISED / Aug 18)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/86ee52367c9f5edb5bbf78095ba0b87e3d93b4e8.png[/img]

[b]Hello! This is an announcement from SoulWorker. 
Here is the Update and Event News for August 18, 2022.[/b]


[b]---------------------------------------------◆ UPDATE ◆---------------------------------------------[/b]

[b]▶ CHANGE – The Logo of SoulWorker[/b]
- A logo will be changed to the SEASON 2 Logo.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/5479734436b7200e1349292553dfc9d19a0488cd.png[/img]

[b]▶ UPDATE – SoulWorker Season 2 : Road To East[/b]
- New District of East Cloudream: 'Arcadia Realm' will be updated.

[How to Enter - Arcadia Realm]
- Can receive the quest through NPC 'Toru' in Grace City.
- Require to clear following 3 quests.
> 'Calm Before the Storm' Quest: Clear [Prayers' Cloister] Maze
> 'Life and Dignity' Quest: NPC 'Senia' → Speak to 'Toru' → Speak to 'Senia'
> 'Soldiers of Humanity' Quest: Clear [Grace Landing] Maze

- Accept 'Operation: Trench Run' Quest → Enable to move to 'Arcadia Realm' through NPC [Heitz] in Grace City.
> If you want to go to Grace City from Arcadia Realm: Enable to move to 'Grace City' through NPC [Heitz] in Arcadia Realm.

- Grace Landing Maze in the 'WEST': Can enter by using 'Operation Order: [Grace Landing]' which can obtain via 'Soldiers of Humanity' Quest.

- New Maze: [Warmingflower Farm] / [Starlight Garden] / [Giant Fear]

[b][Warmingflower Farm][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/c2e4c37fbf6fb567fe7df577580367fd630c0627.png[/img]

[b][Starlight Garden][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/e96c9dd2c6796f38b69316045889b548e0742349.png[/img]

[b][Giant Fear]
[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/14619a93fb74c4c34d6ae6ac051a7e8e253678cd.png[/img]
> How to Enter (Season 2 Mazes): Through NPC [Rona] in Arcadia Realm
> Main Story (EP 1): Can be unlocked after 'Soldiers of Humanity' Quest CLEAR (Character Level must be Lv.76 or Higher)
> Story Maze: Solo Play ONLY / Single Difficulty / 'Scenario Maze' and 'Character Maze'

- 'Spec Ops Maze' will also be updated: [Field of Raid] / [Garden of Plenty] / [Moorland of Solitude]
> Spec Ops Maze: It will be unlocked one at a time when Main Quests for Each Story Theme are entirely cleared.

[b][Spec Ops Maze][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/2f24a145ea9a4d894031a700a3c41145ade0e383.png[/img]

[b][Progression of Season 2][/b]
- No Reward for each step
- Reward: Can only be obtained once
- Clear every scenario → Enable to earn all rewards
- Progression Reward of Arcadia Realm will be updated.
> Clear [Warmingflower Farm] / [Starlight Garden] / [Giant Fear] Mazes to Get 'Token' item.
> Token: Can make useful items through NPC in a certain town or district.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/8084121d6c1f8ed1ec0e7da17d7b511923c0da62.png[/img]

[b][Improvement - CLEAR EXP of Season 1 Main Quests] [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/32948512d9d8910070a2f9f36c50383cacfed046.png[/img]

- Class Up / Desire Awakening Quests will be changed.
1) CLASS UP QUEST: 
> Reach Lv. 57 → NPC Activation Quest ('Fortune Corps. Landing' Quest): Activate 'Miriam' in Grasscover Camp

2) DESIRE AWAKENING QUEST:
> Corrupted Record and Desire Awakening will be separated.
> Reach Lv. 65 → Clear 'The Beginning of a New History' Quest → Accept the quest through NPC 'Brooke' in Dipluce Horizon
> Raid Clear Quests → DELETED

- Some of Season 1 Quests will be Deleted. (If your characters have following quests → Quests will be auto-canceled After Update.)
> Quests: [Maniac] Orca Forces I / II / III
> Quests: A Small Disobedience III / IV


[b]▶ CHANGE – Entry Limit of Some Mazes[/b]
- Entry Limit Change: Innocent Daydream / Second Daydream / Scary Daydream
> (Before Update) Entry Limit: 5 / PLUS: +2 
> (AFTER Update) Entry Limit: 7 / PLUS: No PLUS Bonus


[b]▶ UPDATE - Max Level & New Scenario[/b]
- Max Level Change: (Before) Lv. 76 → (After Update) Lv. 79
- New Main Quest: 22 / Each Character Quest: 9 / New Sub Quest: 4 / New Repeat Quest: 3


[b]▶ CHANGE – Ranking System[/b]
- Solo Maze Rankings will be separated 'by character' (Main Character of Users).
> Total Points Ranking: It will be counted by character based on the Main Character of Users.
> Reward: Can be received for each character.

[b][Ranking Reward Change][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/5b753e5a0b3e73bef548be41a85aadf0b89cdeea.png[/img]

- Ranking Mazes: Score System and Tie-Breaker Process will be changed.
> All Ranking Maze scores are equally distributed 'by Rank' and 'by Top(%)'.
> Ranking Menu → 'Rule of Tie-Breaker': Can check more detailed information.
> In the case of tying in the final points, users with a higher rank in the Specified Ranking Maze will be ranked high.
> Specified Ranking Mazes: No.1 (Tenebris Solo) / No.2 (Flemma Solo) / No.3 (RaphaKumpa Solo)

- Ranking Reward: It will be changed to '[Ranking] Gruton Medal'.
> [Ranking] Gruton Medal: Can be exchanged to useful items at Gruton Coin Shop.

[b][Gruton Medal - Crafting Lists][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/e98dd76fd93e8b2a569f1c0a8bdd10813df958fc.png[/img]

- New Solo Ranking Maze will be updated.
> Based on Broken Savior [Normal / Phase 1]

- Abyss Lounge Ranking / Team Maze Ranking will be DELETED.

- [Warp Orb] Tenebris Challenge Ticket: Using this ticket will allow Player to enter Broken Savior Solo Ranking.
> Can purchase at Gruton Coin Shop


[b]▶ UPDATE – SoulWorker [ GUIDE ][/b]
- New [ GUIDE ] System: It will provide information on Recommended Contents and Equipment for users’ current level.
> It pops up on your in-game screen ONCE A DAY / ONCE per Account when Game Login.
> It also can check at Main Menu.

- Menu of SoulWorker [Guide]: Recommended / Contents / Items / Guide

[b]
▶ UPDATE – New Skills of Characters (Lv.72 Skills)[/b]
- Lv.72 Skill will be updated to Each Character.
- HARD ARMOR effect will be applied to Lv.72 Skills.
- When using Lv.72 Skill → Buff Effect: SoulPlus Power Up 1 Time (Lv.42 Skill's SoulPlus)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/6f4471fb07fc3b385c090c3df6548c11effb4e7d.png[/img]

[b]▶ NEW SYSTEM – Active Skill Auto-Learn / Mastery System[/b]
- Active Skills will be automatically learned when players reach a certain level.
* SoulPlus of Active Skill: Enable to 'Learn' / 'Change' / 'Cancel' in the Skill tab. (No Skill Reset item is required.)
* Passive Skill (Such as 'Tumble' / 'Retaliation'): Consume SP to learn. (Same as Season 1)
* SoulPlus: Enable to 'Learn' / 'Change' / 'Cancel' in any Districts. (Except in Mazes and District 6)

- Mastery: Consume SP to upgrade Character Stats. (Battle Mastery / Technical Mastery)
> Press Skill ( k ) button → Can find Mastery tab
> You can freely add or subtract SPs until you press the 'Apply' button of Mastery.
> SP requirement for Mastery / Passive Skill: It will be fixed to 'Consume SP 1' regardless of level.
> Skill Reset / Skill Tree Reset: SPs that used for Mastery will be reset / returned.
> Ctrl + (Mouse) Left Click: Can consume (or reset) SP 5 at once
> Shift + (Mouse) Left Click: Can consume (or reset) SP Max at once
> After Update → The max SP amount increases according to the character level.
> SPs that used before Update → ALL RESET


[b]▶ UPDATE – Cash Shop
1) NEW TAB - [Transmission] [/b]
- Transmission system (gacha) for Akashic Record / Soul Mate / Brooch / Tag will be added.
> Enable to Receive Mileage: Akashic Record / Soul Mate / Tag Transmission
> Mileage will not be provided: Brooch Transmission

 -[b] FREE Transmission Chance (Once A Day)[/b]: Akashic Record / Soul Mate (REVISED / Aug 18)

[b][Transmission (Cash Shop) - Price Info][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/cfc7f8501fdfdcc9880550f6979ec29c6073be22.png[/img]

[b]2) Shopping Cart[/b]
- (After Update) Can adjust the quantity of some items in the shopping cart.

[b]3) New & Improvement - User Convenience[/b]
- A separate notification will be exposed on the Cash Shop icon when new items are arrived.
- 'Photo' tab: Can check which photo you 'Already Own'.
- Character Preview: 'Fullscreen Mode' will be updated.
- Beauty Items: Preview Camera → Close-up the character's face
- The preview posture does not change when the character is wearing a weapon costume.
- Preview: Can check the character's general/battle gestures.
- Event Cash & Normal Cash: Event Cash is used in preference to Normal Cash.


[b]▶ CHANGE - Mileage Store[/b]
- How to obtain Mileage: (Present) Purchase PKGs that provide Mileages → (After Update) Through Transmission system (Cash Shop) for Akashic Record / Soul Mate / Tag
> PKGs that provide Mileages will be DELETED from Cash Shop.
> Using Transmission system 1 time → Can obtain 'Mileage 1'

- Mileage Store (Gruton Coin Shop): New Sales Tabs will be updated.
> Soul Mate (Mileage) / Tag (Mileage) will be added.
> Akashic Record Mileage Shop: Parable's High-Grade A.R Transmitter and Parable's Hidden A.R Transmitter will be added.
> (After August 18th Update) Mileage will NOT reset at all. (No Monthly Reset)

- Akashic Record Mileage Shop: Purchase Limit and Price will be changed.
> Parable's A.R Transmitter: (Present) Purchase Limit: 10 times per Month / Price: Mileage 6 → (After Update) Purchase Limit: No Purchase Limit / Price: Mileage: 5
> Parable's A.R Transmitter [★4]: (Present) Price: Mileage 13 → (After Update) Price: Mileage 50
> A.R Card Special Select Option [★4] I: (Present) Price: Mileage 50 → (After Update) Price: Mileage 160
> Parable's A.R Transmitter [★5]: (Present) Price: Mileage 65 → (After Update) Price: Mileage 220
> A.R Card Special Select Option [★5] I: (Present) Price: Mileage 100 → (After Update) Price: Mileage 320
> Parable's High-Grade A.R Transmitter: Mileage 15 
> Parable's Hidden A.R Transmitter: Mileage 10

- Your mileage will increase x3.2 times after August 18th Update. (Decimal Point will be deleted / No round off)


[b]▶ NEW SYSTEM – Soul Mate[/b]
- Soul Mate is a companion of SoulWorkers. They can do Auto-Loot (items) and provide Buffs to SoulWorkers!
- [ Y ] button is the shortcut key in the game.
- Soul Mate: Account Basis (Soul Mates will show for all characters on your account.)

[b]1) How to Obtain[/b]
- Can obtain through 'Soul Mate Box'.
- Gather 'Memory Fragment' → 'Release' to obtain
- Cash Shop: Through Soul Mate 'Transmission' system in Cash Shop
- Not possible to hold same Soul Mates: If you obtain existing Soul Mate again → it is automatically converted to a "Memory Fragment"
- Memory Fragment can be purchased at 'Fragment Shop' (Soul Mate Menu) with 'Colorless Memory Fragment: Pet'.

[b]2) Memory Fragment: Soul Mate[/b]
- Use 'Memory Fragment' to raise a Soul Mate's Rank.
- Can purchase at 'Fragment Shop' (Soul Mate Menu) / 'Gruton Coin Shop' (Mileage Store - Soul Mate) / 'Cash Shop' (Transmission - Soul Mate)
- If a Soul Mate's Rank reach MAX:
> Not possible to obtain Memory Fragments of Max Ranked Soul Mate.
> Can obtain 'Colorless Memory Fragment: Pet' instead.

[b]3) Summon / Companion[/b]
- Summon: Can summon a Soul Mate that you choose.
- Companion: (e.g.) Summon 'Haru' Soul Mate and Companion 'Erwin' Soul Mate → 'Erwin' Soul Mate follows you but the buffs of 'Haru' Soul Mate is applied to your character.
- Summon / Dismiss: Possible to do in any Districts.
- In the Maze: If you forget to summon a Soul Mate, you can't summon in the maze. You must summon a Soul Mate BEFORE you enter a maze. ('Dismiss' is not possible, either.)
- Not possible to summon any Soul Mates in ‘District 6’.

[b]4) RANK of Soul Mates[/b]
- Soul Mate Rank: Total of 20 Ranks (C ~ SSS) / Each Soul Mate has a different starting rank.
- Use 'Memory Fragment' to raise a Soul Mate's Rank.
- Rank Up → Soul Mate's Stats will be increased. (Some Soul Mates increase their Stats per Level.)
- Soul Mate 'Story' & 'Voice': Can be unlocked by Rank Up.
- Rank C / Rank B / Rank A: Enable to rank up to ★3
- Rank S / Rank SS: Enable to rank up to ★5
- Rank SSS: MAX RANK (No higher rank exists.)

[b]5) Rename Soul Mate[/b]
 - Can rename your Soul Mates by using 'Soul Mate Name Change' item. (Can purchase at Cash Shop)

[b]6) Level of Soul Mate[/b]
- Soul Mate can obtain EXP as much as FP has consumed AFTER MAZE CLEAR.
- Not possible to get any EXP if leaving without clearing the maze.
- Level Up → Soul Mate's Stats will be increased. (Some Soul Mates increase their Stats per Rank.)

[b]7) Stats of Soul Mate[/b]
- Stats will be increased by Rank / Level.
- 'Max Stats' Button: Enable to check Rank SSS / Lv.30 Stats of Soul Mate

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/426c1f92b9e6038fe34073880f6d0109afa92aa0.png[/img]

- Soul Mates have their own skill.
- Soul Mates have the same Skill regardless of rank. (EXCEPT FOR Betty / Arua / Yorhaka / Poison)

[b]9) Artifacts of Soul Mate[/b]
- Can equip Max 3 Artifacts that increase the Stats of user's Character. (Applies ONLY when the Artifacts-equipped Soul Mate is summoned.)
- Artifacts: BLUE / RED (Can be unlocked Lv.15) / EFFECT (Can be unlocked Lv.30)
> Effect Artifact: Equip Effect Artifact → creates a unique effect around the Soul Mate.
- Artifact Grade: Normal (Lowest) / Magic / Rare / Unique / Legend (Highest)
- Can obtain through Transmission system (Cash Shop).
- Also, chance to obtain at 'Moorland of Solitude' (Season 2)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/2a9cb1aad2278b9c06fa4509a43199aac61d8dae.png[/img]

[b]10) Artifact Combine / Dismantle[/b]
- Combine Artifacts: Can obtain Same Grade Artifacts or Higher Grade Artifacts
> When Combine → Add Artifact x1 → Result: Same Grade Artifact
> To get Higher Grade Artifacts: When Combine, Need to add Certain Amounts of Artifacts.
- Can combine with Same Grade Artifacts (Success Chance: 100%)
- Dismantle Artifacts: Can obtain 'Colorless Memory Fragment: Pet' that allows you to purchase various Memory Fragment of Soul Mates.

[b]11) Stories of Soul Mate[/b]
- Some Soul Mates can unlock their own Stories per Rank.
- Can check which Rank that you can unlock the story. (Soul Mate menu)

[b]12) Voices of Soul Mate[/b]
- Rank A or Higher Rank Soul Mates have their own Voices and can be activated in Special Conditions.
> Voice Conditions can be checked at Soul Mate menu - [Voice]
> Special Conditions of Voice: Some Soul Mates (Haru / Erwin / Lily / Jin / and so on) and Rank S or Higher Rank Soul Mates have their own Special Condition Voices.
> Voice function can be activated from Rank S of Soul Mate.

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/6175be722a1c34cc5772f361753890c817e9e5c9.png[/img]


[b]Hello! This is an announcement from SoulWorker. 
Here is the Update and Event News for May 26, 2022.[/b]

[b]---------------------------------------------◆ UPDATE ◆---------------------------------------------[/b]


[b]▶ BROKEN SAVIOR – [HARD] MODE[/b]
- [Hard] Mode of Broken Savior in which you can see Tenebris immersed in powerful Desire Energy will be added.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/1c92dcbd6fa80f63c22eb93e750875bb08411bbb.png[/img]

[b][How To Enter][/b]
- Can enter through NPC [Arin] in Grace City.
- Solo Play and 2 ~ 4 Players Party Play are available.
- Not possible to enter with Force status.

[b][Number of Valid Entries][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/ec5a6458888a685cc2f17fb763134192dd45584c.jpg[/img]

- Broken Savior doesn't have any Entry Limit. (e.g. If a player has enough FP, No limit to enter the raid.)
- However, Broken Savior has a "Valid Entry" limit.
- Valid Entry: The actual number that a player can obtain Drop Items if a player clears the raid.
> Fail to clear the Raid within Valid Entry Limit → No Reward and Lose 1 chance of Valid Entry Limit
> Leaving in the middle of the Raid → No Reward and Lose 1 chance of Valid Entry Limit
- Valid Entry Limit will be Reset Weekly. (Account Base)
- When a player enters the raid → the Valid Entry Limit will be immediately deducted.
> 2 ~ 4 Players Party Play: Drop Item Rewards are only available for players with Valid Entries remaining.
> (e.g.) 3 players - A, B, C players
A - Valid Entry: 3 (Can obtain rewards) / B - Valid Entry: 0 (No rewards) / C - Valid Entry: 1 (Can obtain rewards)
- Valid Entry Limit will be "Reset Mondays at 01:00 (GMT)".

[b][More About Broken Savior – Hard Mode][/b]
- Required "Accuracy": 2,500 or More 
- Respawn Limit:
> Free Respawn - [3] +2 (PLUS)
> Respawn (with Items) - [3]
> Cash Respawn - [Unlimited]
- Tenebris (Hard Mode) transforms to a different look when 30% of HP is left.
- Not possible to use ACTIVE Akashic Record
- 'Achievement' and 'Title' will be added.
- 2 Repeat Quests for Broken Savior Hard will be added.
> Repeat Quest: Can purchase at [Worker Support Device: Merchants' Union] in Grace City
- 2 New Crafting Materials: 'Shard of Corrupted Justice' and 'Fragment of Power'

[b]▶ EPILOGUE QUEST OF SoulWorker SEASON 1[/b]
- Clear Broken Savior Raid related Quests → New Quest will be added.
> 'New Quest' contains SoulWorker Season 1 Epilogue.
> Clear 'Intermission: Wind from the East' Quest → Speak to NPC [Haifu] in Grace City → Can receive 'Behind The End I' Quest.
> Behind The End I: This is Broken Savior - Hard Mode related scenario quest.


[REWARD LISTS – Broken Savior Hard Mode]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/2e10f27e95dbc2f98b2ac732bc588afe0fbb8e20.png[/img]

[b]▶ BROKEN SAVIOR HERO WEAPON & FAMILIAR[/b]

- Broken Savior Hero Weapons will be added after the update of Broken Savior - Hard.
- How to obtain Picaresque Hero Weapon: 
> Can obtain through Broken Savior Hard Mode (Drop Item)
> Hero Weapon can also be Crafted.
- Broken Savior Hard Mode (Drop Item)
> Players will obtain [Picaresque Hero Weapon Box] in the raid.
> [Picaresque Hero Weapon Box]: A weapon, according to the Current Character, can be obtained.
> [Picaresque Hero Weapon Box]: Not possible to store in the Bank / Can't be sold / Can't be deleted

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/1562ae4e13cce571ff607998461893f20a0b16fb.png[/img]

- Set Bonus: When a player has equipped Picaresque Hero Weapon + Picaresque Gear.
> Set Bonus is the same as before.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/ff5791421c42cb3ab24163108b576140a77fe7df.png[/img]

- NPC [Janice] / [Maxime] in Grace City: Can craft Picaresque Hero Weapon / Weapon Familiar / Gear Familiar

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/bd8fedf4f5518b9a6a42f738aaa5fc7f70156ab7.png[/img]

- Dismantle of Picaresque Hero Weapon: Can obtain 'Ether' (400 ~ 900) and 'Shard of Corrupted Justice' (10 ~ 20)
- Succession of Picaresque Hero Weapon: Can use Succession system for Upgrade Stat and Random Options.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/4594555666010e0096d1b5f0ce510425716709b6.png[/img]

- New Weapon Familiar / Gear Familiar will be added.
> New Familiar: Not possible to trade
- How to obtain New Weapon Familiar / Gear Familiar: 
> Can obtain through Broken Savior Hard Mode (Drop Item)
> New Familiar can also be Crafted.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/88ae79e4924a50e5967adc5758ed7c52de15b928.png[/img]

[b]▶ VIOLENT SUN - NEW ACCESSORY COSTUME[/b]

- New Accessory Costume can be obtained when Phase 3 of Violent Sun is cleared.
> Costumes are NOT dropped by 100% chance.
> For Female Characters: Flaming Vessi Horn / Flaming Vessi Veil

[b][How To Enter]

( ※ Haru Estia / Erwin Arclight: Must clear the Quest [Prepare To Cut Off That Monster's Head] first → then, enable to receive the Quest [How To Cut Off The Monster's Head] )

> Broken Savior 'Scenario Raid' (For Main Quest): 1 Player can play and clear this Scenario Raid.
> This Broken Savior 'Scenario Raid' will not be able to enter after completing the Main Quest.

[b]- Entering the Raid for the First Time[/b]
> After receive the New Quest [Peace in the West... And...] → NPC [Arin] of Grace City: "Transport to the Maze" → Can enter Broken Savior

[b][Number of Valid Entries][/b]
- Broken Savior doesn't have any Entry Limit. (e.g. If a player has enough FP, No limit to enter the raid.)
- However, Broken Savior has a "Valid Entry" limit.
- Valid Entry: The actual number that a player can obtain Drop Items if a player clears the raid.
> Fail to clear the Raid within Valid Entry Limit → No Reward and Lose 1 chance of Valid Entry Limit
> Leaving in the middle of the Raid → No Reward and Lose 1 chance of Valid Entry Limit
- Valid Entry Limit will be Reset Weekly. (Account Base)
- The number of valid entries is 20 per week and will be added 2 times when Soul "PLUS" is activated.
- When a player enters the raid → the Valid Entry Limit will be immediately deducted.
> 2 ~ 4 Players Party Play: Drop Item Rewards are only available for players with Valid Entries remaining.
> (e.g.) 3 players - A, B, C players
A - Valid Entry: 3 (Can obtain rewards) / B - Valid Entry: 0 (No rewards) / C - Valid Entry: 1 (Can obtain rewards)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/4e703e794dbf35caa9ec04ee13e76c3c1deab989.jpg[/img]

[b]▶ GRAND NEW RAID – [BROKEN SAVIOR][/b]

-Synopsis-
[i]I saw the light the day I was captured by the false illusion of justice.

This light put a stop to what I thought to be right.
This light of awakening made the ignorant hero inside rising once again.

The general justice I thought to be right crumbled that day along with her bitter smile.

Was my definition of justice insignificant? No, it's because her powers grew stronger.
Power was the only thing with the right of justifying justice.
That's why today... here... I will raise my sword to put into action the reality of the justice I have come to know.

This place has long been abandoned, once burning with my body due to Rosca's fierce light.
This place stands in remembrance of the mundane victory of Starry Forest League.

I stand here once more as I did before with my head held high in a different direction.[/i]

> Raid Entry has No Limit. However, there is Reward Limit.
> Reward Limit: The number of times that players can obtain the actual reward.
> Reward Limit is 20 per week.
> When a player enters the raid → the Reward Limit will be immediately deducted.
> Reward Condition: Must Clear the Raid within Reward Limit (20).
> Fail to clear the Raid within Reward Limit → No Reward and Lose 1 chance of Reward Limit
> Leaving in the middle of the Raid → No Reward and Lose 1 chance of Reward Limit

- Total Phase: 2
> Must clear Phase 1 within a fixed time to enter Phase 2.
- A reward can be changed according to the Phase that is cleared.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/47d022e72b74b20c917002499cc10b28a979d4ae.png[/img]


- Press 'TAB' button to use after setting up.
- Can change the hotkey: [Settings] → [Hotkeys]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/5fe5ff18a8fc2281daa4d844aff5e534f8d05847.png[/img]

- Voice Wheel of different lines for each character will be applied.
- Voice Wheel will appear to other team members in the Team / Force state.
- Voice Wheel will also appear to the Team / Force members in the other district.
- When using Voice Wheel → Speaker icon will be displayed. So, can realize who has used the Voice Wheel.

- If equip more than one Victory Poses → One of the equipped Victory Poses will be randomly displayed when clear the maze.
- After the update → Default setting of Victory Pose: All Random
- If equip any Victory Pose → All Random will be disabled.
- No Victory Pose is equipped → All Random will be activated again.

 ※ Can choose 2 basic victory poses for each character.
※ NPC [Style Maker]: Can craft additional Victory Pose.

[ Victory Pose Lists (Crafting) ]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/415783ef1e1f05db9d2371c56258c099df1f3d2b.png[/img]

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/6175be722a1c34cc5772f361753890c817e9e5c9.png[/img]


[b]Hello! This is an announcement from SoulWorker. 
Here is the Update and Event News for March 3, 2022.[/b]

[b]---------------------------------------------◆ UPDATE ◆---------------------------------------------[/b]

[b]▶ SYSTEM CHANGE – BANK (ACCOUNT BASIS)[/b]
[b]1. Bank System: Account Basis[/b]
- 'BANK' system of NPC [Oden] will be changed.
> Account Basis & Can share with other characters

- NO MORE Previous Bank System (Each Character Basis / Not shared with other characters)

- Items stored in the bank → Move to Players' H.E.M.S of [Received] tab during the update
> [Very Important] Only up to 100 mails are displayed.
> [Very Important] 100 mails → Receive Items and Delete Mails → Rest of New E-mails will appear
> Each mail expires on December 31st, 2030.

- Bank Expansion Data will also be initialized.
> 'Union Bank V.I.P Card' will be given as many times as each character has used before the update.
> 'Union Bank V.I.P Card' will be provided to H.E.M.S of [System Mail] tab during the update.
> Each mail expires on December 31st, 2030.

[b]2. Money System: Account Basis[/b]
- Money: Zenny / Ether / BP
- No More Each Character Basis → (After the update) Account Basis
- After the update → Zenny / Ether / BP of Each Character → It will be ALL COMBINED.

[b]3. Some Items: Change to [Cannot be stored in the Bank][/b]
(Items that are currently set as 'Cannot be stored in the Bank' will remain the same as before.)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/7a36d743cd00e5cbabe80997aa6b6b03b4fdbf76.png[/img]

[b]4. Daily Attendance Reward / Stay Connected Reward / Consecutive Attendance Reward[/b]
- Reward Check System: (Previous) Each Character Basis → (After the update) Account Basis
- Attendance Rewards of March 1st / March 2nd, 2022 will be initialized and accumulated from the beginning.

[b]5. Daily Missions[/b]
- The Progress Unit will be changed to Account Basis.

[b]6. Purchase Limits of Some Items from Shops[/b]
- Some Items: (Previous) Character Basis Purchase Limit → (After the update) Account Basis Purchase Limit
- Items that have changed the condition of Purchase Limits → (After the update) The number of Purchase Limits will be initialized.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/520e3072efd946be847917526e672590a5ecfbc7.png[/img]

[b]7. League Raid Coins[/b]
- The number of League Raid Coins acquired will be changed between Main Character and Non-main Character.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/d1850b448c620dcdb81bd28b44086a956c608f01.png[/img]

[b]8. Purchase Limits of Some Items from Cash Shop[/b]
- Some Items: (Previous) Character Basis Purchase Limit → (After the update) Account Basis Purchase Limit
- Items that have changed the condition of Purchase Limits → (After the update) The number of Purchase Limits will be initialized.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/3272d5041fe08ebfd7aaf771d24161395b2eff61.png[/img]

[b]9. Soul Pass[/b]
- The progress of the Soul Pass will be changed → Share by All Characters
- Soul Pass Reward: Can only receive once per account
- This change will be applied to the next Soul Pass.

[b]10. Maze Entry Number[/b]
- Mazes with Entry Limits: (Previous) Each Character Basis → (After the update) Account Basis
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/5acbc1c5fd8548bb7aee5960595c3c64ba17b671.png[/img]

e.g.) [Violent Sun] Maze
- Total Entry Limits of Violent Sun = 4

> Account A
> Account A's Characters: 1 and 2
> If Character 1 → Clear Violent Sun 1 time
> Character 2 → Can clear Max 3 times


[b]11. [The Primal Hero] will be closed and removed[/b]
- [Lunar Fall Hero] will be opened irregularly.

[b]12. Events[/b]
- Event Progress / Event Crafting Lists / Event Item Rewards: (Previous) Each Character Basis → (After the update) Account Basis
- However, there are still chances that some event items (from future events) may be provided as Each Character Basis.
- This change will be applied from March First Update.


[b]▶ MORE CHANGES AND FIXES[/b]
- [Available Characters] will be displayed in the costume link package that can be obtained through Cash Shop Random Boxes. (e.g. Corrupted Fearful Wing Costume PKG)
- Buff Tooltip Issue has been fixed. (Issue: Use some of the Buff items → Incorrect Tooltip shows up)
- [LUNAR NEW YEAR EVENT] item / crafting item issue has been fixed. (Issue: Event items → Not possible to Discard or Delete or Sell.)
- Soul Pass issue has been fixed. (Issue: Even Soul Pass already ends, the Pass Points mark remains in the Daily Mission.)
- "City Devoured by Desire" (Ephnel) quest issue has been fixed. (Issue: During the quest by Ephnel, the lines and characters do not match.)
- The 2nd League Event: The reward will be provided to those who participated and did not participate in the event. (Those who have already received the reward before the update → No reward will be provided again.)


[b]---------------------------------------------◆ EVENT ◆---------------------------------------------[/b]

[b]1. NEW EVENT BEGINS – [MARCH DICE EVENT] [/b]
- Event Period: March 3rd, 2022 Update ~ March 31st, 2022 Update
- Event Recap:
1) Clear Daily Missions to obtain '[EV] Dice' event item.
2) [EV] Dice: Allow to play a Dice Mini Game.
3) Dice Board Tile Reward / Dice Used Reward / Lap Completion Reward: Can obtain various items.

[ DICE USED REWARDS ]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/d2f3b441f3f05f3007f7dd6d033bc544938e20d9.png[/img]

[ LAP COMPLETION REWARDS ] 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/dfab002a76f4742887bd03f8b1815e752f32ceb1.png[/img]

[b]2. THE EVENT ENDS - [Valentine’s Day Event][/b]

---------------------------------------------◆ SHOP ◆---------------------------------------------[/b]

notes.title: [Notice] 220127 Update Note Preview
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/2dd01f5cba2cb62d0ded9d2005f929acf2db8373.png[/img]


[b]Hello! This is an announcement from SoulWorker. 
Here is the Update and Event News for January 27, 2022.
[/b]
[b]---------------------------------------------◆ UPDATE ◆---------------------------------------------[/b]

[b]1. NEW SYSTEM: EQUIPMENT SUCCESSION (WEAPON / GEAR)[/b]
- Succession: Can implant some of upgrade stats and options in the equipment from the upper raid into the higher tier equipment.

- How to Use
> Which NPC: NPC [Trisha] from each district
> Which Equipment: Above Lv.68 and LEGEND equipment
> Put down the equipment that you want to succeed → Can check a list of equipment that can receive Succession.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/9bb26382cc835aa05c6c8c3ad5180f4e6f9ff303.png[/img]

> Which Equipment can provide Succession: Upgrade Stat at least +3 equipment
> Which Equipment can receive Succession: Equipment that has No Upgrade Stat
> The "Succession Number" will be added to the equipment that can receive Succession.
> Succession-Provide Equipment: It should not contain any Familiar / Soulstone. Can use Succession after extract Familiar / Soulstone.
> Equipment equipped with non-extractable LEGEND or Higher Familiar: Can provide Succession. Equipment and Familiar will be deleted after Succession process.
> To use Succession: Require "Succession Device" item. This can be crafted through NPC [Janice].
> Succession of Upgrade Stats: the upgrade stat value will be reduced (value: -3) when it is implanted.
> Succession of Random Options: Can implant only one option. However, the option's stat value will be randomly determined.
> Not allow to provide options that Equipment is not possible to have.
> Option lists that Succession Receive Equipment can take: Enable to check through the 'Option Info' button.
> Not allow to receive duplicate options.
> When options are all the same between Succession Provide and Receive Equipment → Only Upgrade Stat Value will succeed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/5a978afad704b64eec6297f954fe57da56c49d16.png[/img]

> 'Upgrade-Protection Memory' item can alleviate decreasing upgrade stat value. Can purchase at Cash Shop.
> 'Add-Option Memory' item allows you to implant up to two options. Can purchase at Cash Shop.

- Equipment Lists for Succession

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/b7985b78e4c8a727e2ea1bec7713fb8045494505.png[/img]

[b]2. SOUL PASS – SEASON 2[/b]
- A new season of Soul Pass (Season 2) will begin. Can obtain Pass Points by Playing Game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/4f589787133a2b276f31a8c79a4d2275ed1f9905.png[/img]

 > Soul Pass Season 2 Entire Period: January 27th Update ~ February 17th, 01:00 (GMT)
 > Can participate once per character. Can proceed with all characters in the account.
 > How to Use: Can find and use [Soul Pass] icon at the bottom right during the Season 2 Period.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/9e14a550d23f7a04286422c0014c04b2e1e461d2.png[/img]

- Pass Point: Can obtain through Maze Clear / Daily Mission Complete / Pass Mission Complete

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/9d138ee69d497fa9535bd66cd6d4f90348743a8d.png[/img]

> Pass Point Rewards can be obtained according to Pass Tiers. (Total of 20 Tiers)
> Pass Point Rewards will be sent to the player's H.E.M.S of [Received] tab.

[b]---------------------------------------------◆ UPDATE ◆---------------------------------------------[/b]

[b]1. NEW PREMIUM COSTUME – ‘SHINING STAR ON STAGE’[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/4fcac3d1246a6c092ed6e6b8ffc1bcaa78f077cc.jpg[/img]

[b]2. NEW DISTRICT – ‘SERENUS SPICA’[/b]

- Serenus Spica: This is a new district where so many users can gather to talk and take awesome screenshots.
- [Warp Orb] Serenus Spica: Can purchase at Gruton Coin Shop with the price of 30 Gruton Coin.
- Not allow to use any Social Items and Maze Warp Orbs. (Except Warp Orbs for Districts)
- Also, not allow to move to My Room.


[b]3. EQUALIZER IMPROVEMENT: SEPARATION OF VOICE / SKILL EFFECT[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/8130bbbf67b406d79597a93484eb3e91b305e35d.png[/img]
- When using an Equalizer, Voice and Skill Effect can be selected with different themes. (e.g. Voice - Theme A / Skill Effect - Theme B)
* Previously equipped equalizers will be unequipped after the update. You need to equip again.
- Equalizer: Can find at [Profile] > [Costume Item] > Voice / Effect (Equalizer)
- Click the UI of 'Voice / Effect' → Equalizer window will be activated.
- Extracted Equalizer: Can be obtained from Costume Extraction. Use Equalizer to register in Voice / Effect.

[b]4. VIOLENT SUN – NEW DROPS & CRAFTING LISTS[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/523a860a117f2f05b41a41b0c8194880ebda1fa6.png[/img]

- NPC [Maxime] of Grace City: Can craft Dancing Scarlet Butterfly / Ivory Mayhem Usher / Re-Tag Chip (Require 'Pale Fragment' to craft)
 > New costumes: Bind on Equip / Not allow to Seal

[b]5. GRASSCOVER CAMP - NEW MEMORIALS & IMPROVEMENT[/b]

- 12 new memorial objects will be added to the mazes of Grasscover Camp.

> (Costume) Flaming Vessi Blindfold / Glasses of Lord
> (My Room Furniture) Ralph Figure / Medal Display Frame

[b]6. MORE CHANGES AND FIXES[/b]

- Log-in Title Screen will be changed.
- Crafting Limitation Initialization Issue has been fixed. (Issue: Craft items that have a monthly limit on the very first day of a month (16:00 ~ 00:59, GMT) → Monthly Limitation does not reset at 01:00 GMT.)
 > Characters who have been experienced this issue → After the update, restore the count mentioned above that crafted from the first of a month.
- Lily’s 'Cat Ears Hairband' costume issue has been fixed. (Issue: the costume is not in the right position.)
- Summoned Object Issue has been fixed. (Issue: Summoned objects such as Akashic Record 'Big Puppet' / 'Ralph' or Lee Nabi 'Bomb Wick' are destroyed by monsters' attack.)
- The Refinement Selection Point Issue has been fixed. (Issue: No Refinement Selection Point accumulations when using '[LIMITED] Energy Converter' from [Lonely Christmas Event].)
 > Refinement Selection Points that are not accumulated → It will be added after the update.
 > [LIMITED] Energy Converter: It will not be possible to use after the update (Effect Expires: January 13th, 2022 Update). Please use it before the update.
- [Social Item] Mini Stage: Can be purchased at Gruton Coin Shop  (1/13 Added)
 >  'Bless' Buff will be applied upon 1 minute of use.
('Bless' Buff: Can be revived without any resurrection items within 20 minutes. After Respawn, the buff will disappear when Exit of a Maze and Restart Maze.)

[b]1. NEW EVENT BEGINS - [NEW YEAR ROCK-PAPER-SCISSORS EVENT] (January 13th, 2022 Update ~ January 27th, 2022 Update)[/b]

- Crafting lists will also be removed and related event items can be sold to the shop.

[b]3. THE EVENT ENDS - [EVENT COUNT BOX SELECT OPTION EVENT][/b]

- [EV] Event Count Box Select Option / [EV] Newcomer Welcome Count Box / [EV] Welcome Back Count Box: Those items will disappear regardless of whether it is used or not.
* Items that have obtained from Count Box: It will remain in your inventory.

[b]4. THE EVENT ENDS - [NEW YEAR DAILY MISSION EVENT][/b]
- Crafting lists will also be removed and related event items can be sold to the shop.

[b]5. THE EVENT ENDS - [WELCOME COUNT BOX EVENT FOR NEW & RETURNING PLAYERS][/b]

> After January 27th, 2022 Update, it will be changed to indefinite regular sales with a normal price.

[b]◆ 2022 January Update Preview[/b]

[b]☞ January First Update[/b]

[b]▶ EQUALIZER IMPROVEMENT: SEPARATION OF VOICE / SKILL EFFECT[/b]
- When using an Equalizer, Voice and Skill Effect can be selected with different themes. (e.g. Voice - Theme A / Skill Effect - Theme B)

[b]▶ VIOLENT SUN - ADDITIONAL REWARDS[/b]
- Additional New Drops
 > (When clear Phase 3 of Violent Sun) Dancing Scarlet Butterfly / Ivory Mayhem Usher costume have a chance to obtain with a low drop rate.
- Additional New Crafting Lists
 > NPC [Maxime] of Grace City: Can craft Dancing Scarlet Butterfly / Ivory Mayhem Usher / Re-Tag Chip

[b]▶ NEW PREMIUM COSTUME – ‘SHINING STAR ON STAGE’[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/6487d7d4d8ab0c80196dc2bb6fd59c1182f30b91.png[/img]
- 'Shining Star on Stage' costume with the concept of pop idol singers will be added.
- 'Shining Star on Stage' costume includes an Equalizer.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/9235f5c4b725bbf26e5f9243f851b8181ab2ab42.png[/img]
- 'Serenus Spica', the stage-style district for this costume concept, will also be newly added.

[b]▶ NEW MEMORIAL FOR GRASSCOVER CAMP[/b]
- A new memorial for Grasscover Camp will be added.
- The reward for the memorial will be a new accessory costume. Also enable to experience a sub-story.


[b]☞ January Second Update[/b]

[b]▶ NEW SYSTEM: EQUIPMENT SUCCESSION (WEAPON / GEAR)[/b]
- Can implant some of upgrade stats and random options in the equipment into the upper equipment.
- Equipment Succession requires 'Succession Device' item which can be crafted from NPC [Janice].
- Succession of Upgrade Stats: the upgrade stat value will be slightly reduced when it is implanted.
 > 'Upgrade-Protection Memory' item can alleviate decreasing upgrade stat value.

notes.title: [Notice] Compensation for the drop rate issue of Parable's A.R Transmitter
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/92dc2400b43404a93ece1df73fe2c3b6ced82bb3.png[/img]

Hello, this is an announcement from SoulWorker.
We are here to inform you that there was an issue found with the drop rate of Akashic Record.
Since the update of Parable’s A.R Transmitter on September 2, 2021, ★5’s drop rate (1.2%) should have been the same rate as ‘New History's A.R Transmitter’. However, after a careful internal investigation, it has been confirmed that ★5’s drop rate of Parable's A.R Transmitter is currently set as 2.4%. Various other drop rates have been thoroughly checked and no other issues have been found except Parable's Akashic Record Transmitter. 

We truly apologize for causing concerns to all users with unstable services. After the Parable's A.R Transmitter update, several other special A.R Transmitters were released. Those A.R Transmitter have also been checked entirely, and the ★5's drop rate of those was set as accurate as 1.2%. Since those transmitters had informed that there was the same drop rate as Parable's A.R Transmitter, the following compensation will be provided to users who purchased the issued A.R Transmitter below.

The details are as follows:
- Eligible for Compensation: Users who have purchased 2021 Illuminated A.R Transmitter / Halloween Special A.R Transmitter and related products

- Compensation in detail: Parable's A.R Transmitter will be provided as equal as each user has purchased 2021 Illuminated A.R Transmitter / Halloween Special A.R Transmitter before the update.

e.g.) If purchased: 2021 Illuminated A.R Transmitter PKG III x2 / 2021 Illuminated A.R Transmitter x 5 / Halloween Special A.R Transmitter x3

> Parable's A.R Transmitter (55+55+5+3) 118 will be provided.

- Compensation Date: After the update of December 9, 2021

★5’s drop rate of Parable's A.R Transmitter will be adjusted while December’s First Update is taken. 
The rate will be changed from 2.4% to 1.2% as same as with other transmitters. 

Once again, we sincerely apologize for any caused inconvenience and will try to provide a fair environment for your gameplay.
Thank you.

tags.balance_change: ★5’s drop rate of Parable's A.R Transmitter will be adjusted while December’s First Update is taken.

> Energy Converter
> Energy Converter Component Box
> [4th~6th Grade] Attack / Defense Re-Tag Chip
> Bluelight Dust

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/aa0480c460a3325e790ca492f7a3c6e8779e15ef.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/50b4c7e0b844e3f2b6aa5bb06a1ecf86e58b7df0.png[/img]

- '[EV] Heart Coin' will be added to Stay Connected Reward.

notes.title: [Notice] 211111 Update Note Preview
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/6175be722a1c34cc5772f361753890c817e9e5c9.png[/img]


Hello! This is an announcement from SoulWorker. 
Here is the Update and Event News for November 11, 2021.

[b]---------------------------------------------◆ UPDATE ◆---------------------------------------------[/b]

[b]1. LEAGUE SYSTEM IMPROVEMENTS[/b]
- The display method of league members will be changed.
- [Members] Tab Sorting: Members, who are currently logged in, will show at the top.
- League Fund: Unit classification marks will be added.
- The indication position of league skill will be changed below the league fund.
- The display method of league announcement will be changed.
- The title bar of the league window will be changed to display a name of the league.
- 'League Emblem Change' Ticket: Enable to check at the League Master Menu → [League Emblem] Tab
 > New League Marks / Emblems will be added.
- The location of 'Message' (League Search) will be changed. Enable to find at the League Master Menu → [Rights] Tab.
- The location of 'Leave' button will be changed to the top of the league member.
- New Function: Reset All League Skills
 > League skills will be able to reset by using the League Fund.
 > Can be used by the League Master only. Require 3,000,000 League Fund to use Reset All League Skills.

[b][League Attendance][/b]
- Attendance Rewards: Individual attendance + League Members' attendance on each day of the week
- Attendance Check Reset: 01:00 (GMT) every day
 > It will be checked that who will receive an extra reward when attendance is reset. If the conditions are satisfied, Attendance reward + Extra reward (Previous day) can be obtained.
 > The reward will be sent to the player's H.E.M.S of [Received] tab.

[b][League Shop][/b]
- How To Use: Find NPC [Seres] - 'Shop' function
- Can purchase with the League Fund only.
- Item purchases can be made regardless of positions in the League.
- Each item has daily purchase restrictions per character.
- There is no [Buyback] tab. Sell and Dismantle are also not possible.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/9658d6ebb36da8c67975ff8d1f5a4a9f3831871d.png[/img]

[b]2. MAZE FOR LEAGUE - ‘LEGION INVADER’[/b]

[b][Entry Requirements][/b]
- Above Lv. 55 can enter.
- Only the Same League Members are enabled to enter this maze.

[b][How To Enter][/b]
- The League [Master / Vice Master / Admin] can open the maze at any time of the week.
- It requires 10,000 Zenny (League Fund) to activate the maze.
- The maze can be activated twice a week. It lasts 48 hours after the maze is activated.
- 1 ~ 4 player parties can enter.
- Each member can enter only once when activated.
- For 2 ~ 4 player parties, only the Team Leader can apply for entry to the maze.
- Activation Weekly Reset: Mondays at 01:00 (GMT)
- Unable to activate 30 minutes before the activation weekly reset time and the activated maze will also be closed.

[b][About Maze][/b]
- The maze runs for a total of 5 minutes only, and it automatically ends after 5 minutes.
- There is a total of 15 phases of monster defeat.
- Enable to gain a score assigned to monsters when defeating monsters.
- No scores on monsters that are automatically killed when the maze ends.
- 'My Score' can be found in league records and the league raid activation button.
- The total score obtained by the league members will be initialized on a weekly basis.
- Enable to use Active/Passive Akashic Records.
- No limit to use Respawn.
- No Item / Zenny / Ether drops. Also, no EXP / SV gains.
- A member who has participated the league raid cannot be expelled or leave from the League until the maze is deactivated.

[b][Rewards][/b]
- League Raid Coin is the reward. Enable to purchase items with this coin from NPC [Seres].
- The League Raid Reward will be given according to individual clear score. It will be sent to the player's H.E.M.S of [Received] tab.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/b0c849a7139c0c479e42b37b9e4d8bf8208d0a85.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/35e5f934cd71770d0edec0ad231e53b0066dbda1.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/275ccaea4c0139f9d951748353a738d5d13efbb6.png[/img]

[b]3. SOUL PASS - SEASON 1 (November 11th Update ~ December 9th Update)[/b]
- Soul Pass Season 1 Entire Period: November 11th Update ~ December 9th, 2021 01:00 (GMT)
- Soul Pass: Can obtain Pass Points by Playing Game. Can receive Rewards with Pass Points.
- Pass Point: Can obtain through Maze Clear / Daily Mission Complete / Pass Mission Complete
 > Pass Point Rewards can be obtained according to Pass Tiers. Rewards will be sent to the player's H.E.M.S of [Received] tab.
- Premium Reward: Can obtain by purchasing 'Pass Upgrade'
- Tier / Pass Upgrade: Not shared at all. Each character basis.
- Premium Tier 20 Reward: Perky Arua Costume PKG

[b]* Caution: All Soul Pass includes will be ended on December 9th regardless of its purchase date. 
[/b]

[b]4. RANKING SYSTEM CHANGE[/b]
- The Maze for Solo Maze Rankings will be changed.
 > Second Daydream will be no more ranking maze.
 > Scary Daydream will be updated as the new ranking maze.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/9f7f4c560d4d8e974d47962e1c4f4c92b6c167c7.png[/img]

[b]5. ABYSS LOUNGE EXPANSION[/b]
- New wave will be added.
- The score of ordinary monsters that respawn indefinitely will be changed.
- Some patterns of monsters (Catch / Invincible patterns and Mode Change) will be removed.


[b]6. MORE CHANGES AND FIXES[/b]
- Translation issues regarding Akashic Release Function has been fixed.
- A graphics error regarding Chii's [Blood Moon Eve] Boots costume has been fixed.
- Chii's 'Position: Bloodbath' skill issue has been fixed. (Issue: Buff effect appears at the bottom of the weapon)
- A graphic texture duplication issue regarding Erwin's [White Sandy Beach] Jacket and Backpack has been fixed.
- During the [Crimson March I ~ III] quests with Iris, questline absence problems have been fixed.

[b]---------------------------------------------◆ EVENT ◆---------------------------------------------[/b]

[b]1. NEW EVENT BEGINS - [2021 Autumn Roulette Event] (November 11th Update ~ November 25th Update)[/b]
- Clear daily missions to obtain '[EV] 2021 Autumn Roulette Ticket'
 > Not enable to obtain any event tickets through the daily mission of 'Clear [Violent Sun] x3'
- Can participate in the event with '[EV] 2021 Autumn Roulette Ticket' and enable to randomly obtain items such as 'Unified TERA Brooch Cube (Possession)', 'Energy Converter', and many more.

[b]2. THE EVENT ENDS - [Moonlight Party Event][/b]
- The '[Warp Orb] Moonlight Party' will not available anymore. It will be also removed from NPC [Gruton Coin Shop].
- Crafting lists will be removed, and related event items can be sold to the shop.

[b]---------------------------------------------◆ SHOP ◆---------------------------------------------[/b]

[b]1. NEW RELEASES & THE END OF SALES [/b]
1) ‘April Fantasy’ Costume PKG (November 11th Update ~ November 25th Update)
For - All Characters

2) ‘April Fantasy’ Photo (Indefinitely)
For - All Characters

3) ‘Shadow Whisper’ Costume PKG (November 11th Update ~ November 25th Update)
For - All Characters

4) ‘Paradise Seeker’ Costume PKG (November 11th Update ~ November 25th Update)
For - All Characters (Except Lee Nabi)

5) ‘Silver Knights’ Costume PKG (November 11th Update ~ November 25th Update)
For - All Characters (Except Lee Nabi)

6) Costume Support PKG (November 11th Update ~ November 25th Update)
 - Included items are listed below.
 > Random Dye Eyedropper x 50
 > Brooch Socket Implement x 5
 > Brooch Extractor x 15

7) ‘Sacred Judgement‘ Costume will be no longer purchasable.
For - All Characters

8) ‘Nightmare-themed ‘ Costume will be no longer purchasable.
For - All Characters

9) ‘Royalty & Hunters of the Pale Night‘ Costume will be no longer purchasable.
For - All Characters

10) ‘Trick or Treat‘ Costume will be no longer purchasable.
For – Haru / Erwin / Lily / Jin / Stella / Iris

11) ‘Seductive Stockings‘ Costume will be no longer purchasable.
    For – Haru / Lily / Stella / Iris / Chii / Ephnel / Lee Nabi

12) ‘Blood Moon Eve‘ Costume will be no longer purchasable.
For - All Characters

13) Discount on [Furniture PKG] Halloween [A], [B], [C] will be no longer applied.
14) Discount on [Furniture PKG] Gothic [A], [B], [C] will be no longer applied.
15) Discount on [Interior PKG] Halloween [A], [B], [C] will be no longer applied.
16) Discount on [Interior PKG] Gothic [A], [B], [C] will be no longer applied.
17) ‘Halloween Special A.R Transmitter' item and PKG will be no longer purchasable.
18) ‘Halloween Special What’ll We Pick Cube' will be no longer purchasable.

[b]2. PREVIOUS PRODUCT ADJUSTMENTS[/b]
1) The price of some My Room Furniture PKG has changed.
- Details are as follows:
> [Furniture PKG] Japanese Style [A], [B], [C] 1720 → 1680
> [Furniture PKG] Elegant [A], [B], [C] 1800 → 1760
> [Furniture PKG] Summer Vacation 1520 →1480
> [Furniture PKG] Cookie [A], [B], [C] 1760 → 1680
> [Interior PKG] Cookie [A], [B], [C] 1480 → 1440

notes.title: [Notice] 2021 November Update Preview
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/6175be722a1c34cc5772f361753890c817e9e5c9.png[/img]

[b]◆ 2021 November Update Preview[/b]

[b]☞ November First Update[/b]

[b]▶ LEAGUE SYSTEM IMPROVEMENTS[/b]
- Attendance
 > Can obtain a League Attendance Reward when attending at the League window.
 > Can obtain Additional Rewards if more and more League members attend.
- League Shop
 > Can purchase items at the League Shop using League Funds.
 > Item purchases can be made regardless of League Position.
- League Window
 > The location of some icons will be changed, and functions will be improved. (e.g. Enable to see pictures of League Members)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/1867d86d09dc1e4389b9655f1befd6abf59ebd18.png[/img]

[b]▶ MAZE FOR LEAGUE - ‘LEGION INVADER’[/b]
- Only the party with Same League Members is enabled to enter this maze.
- The League [Master/Vice Master/Admin] can open the maze at any time of the week. Can obtain the rewards at the end of the Maze.
- Each member can enter only once when activated. The maze can be activated twice a week.
- When the maze is deactivated, rewards for monster defeat will be provided to all the participants who clear the maze.
- Enable to use Active/Passive Akashic Records.

[b]▶ ABYSS LOUNGE EXPANSION & RANKING MAZE CHANGE[/b]
- Max Phase of Abyss Lounge, the current ranking maze, will be expanded.
- Ranking Maze Change: Second Daydream will be changed to Scary Daydream.
* For update, Ranking System will be off from 00:00 (GMT+8) on November 8th. It will be activated again after the update on November 11th.

[b]▶ SOUL PASS SEAON 1[/b]
- New System: Can obtain Pass Points by Playing Game. Can receive Additional Rewards with Pass Points.
- Pass Rewards: Free Reward / Premium Reward (Purchase 'Pass Upgrade' To Unlock Premium Reward)
- Soul Pass will be open for a limited time.


[b]☞ November Second Update[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/6c85efa2412c8f1bb4b36eb107a7c1496cee8ccb.png[/img]

[b]▶ NEW MAZE - ‘LUNAR FALL HERO’[/b]
- Lunar Fall Hero, a Superior version of Lunar Fall will be newly added.
- It requires a different attack strategy than the existing Luna Fall maze.
- Above Lv. 72 can enter. (Required Equipment Specifications: Same or Higher for 'Violent Sun' Phase 3 Clear)
- Lunar Fall Hero will be open for a limited time only.

[b]▶ ACCESSORY TAG[/b]
- Tags for Accessories will be newly added.
- Tag Chip for Accessory Tag can be obtained through in-game play and cash shop.

[b]▶ CHARACTER BALANCE PATCH: LEE NABI[/b]
- Some skills will be changed to make combat tactics easier than before.
> Skills for Balance Patch: SoulStrike Mastery / Reload / DestroNail / Bolt Enhancement / Save Energy / Triple Sniping / Hit And Run / Bust Driver / Honey Bee


Please look forward to our Upcoming November Update. 
Thank you so much.

※ The update in detail may be altered due to unprecedented internal issues.

notes.content:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/78e09c2663647f81c8a303df16b0d1a0a88ef9a9.png[/img]

- Above Level 72
- Daily limitation Count: 2 per characters  
- The access count will be shared among Innocent and Second Daydream. 

E.g.) Access to Second Daydream Once + Access to Scary Daydream Once = Further Access no longer available a day
- A new quest [Unending Nightmare] will be newly added in order to access the Scary Daydream.
- The Maze Completion time will be counted when showing the first paragraph of Setsuka. (Scary Daydream Only) 

[b]▶ How to Access [/b]
- The maze can be accessible upon the completion of quest [Unending Nightmare], and the quest can be received from NPC [Benjamin] in Grace City. 
- Requirement:  [Last Radiance] – (The Main Quest regarding Hell City EP 4)
                     [The Second Dream of a Pure Girl] – (The Access Quest regarding Second Daydream) 

[b]▶ Further Guidelines: Scary Daydream[/b] 
- Total 5 Rounds 
- Completed when eliminating all monsters 
- The Progress rate of [Special Maze] category will now be completed as 100%. 
> Rewards: 
-       Energy Converter x5 
-	Anti-Destruction Device x10 
-	Refine Point Charge Cell+100 x3
-	High-Grade Attack Tag Transmitter II x2

- New Function of extracting owned costumes of gestures and equalizer will be newly added. 
- Can be conducted from NPC Style Maker in each district
※	Based on October 21st Update, both Romance and Nightmare-themed Costumes are only available for extraction. 
※	Gestures and Equalizers being extracted will be modified to Consumables (Possession) of your character. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/69aadb11c5190c3a2d3640137042ae7100aa8b2c.png[/img]

- To extract, you are required to register part of costume regarding the use of Gesture and Equalizer. 
- When completed, the object will be deleted. 
- Extraction Cost: 10,000,000 Zenny

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/7bc2b99fbc9030104c39a386ee9c0a8b0e625734.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/c227a4ff30ca06fb080e628b58e45d55f0752522.png[/img]

- When extracting Costumes purchased from Cash Chop, [Fabric For Repairs] will be obtained. 
- When extracting the Costumes mentioned above not having those options, No Zenny will be required. 
- When extracting dyed one, additional resources will be provided. 
- Some Costumes can be crafted by using the item [Fabric For Repairs].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/d452ef70fd4bbbeaac56415d9d600e8e8e6a23c1.jpg[/img]

※ Based on October 21st Update, Romance and Blossom and Nightmare-themed Costume will only be craftable. 
※ Craftable Listing will be updated by following updates. 
※ When crafting Costumes with [Fabric For Repairs], Gesture/Equalizer function will not be provided. 
※ When crafting Costumes with [Fabric For Repairs], Brooch equipping function will not be provided. 
※ When crafting Costumes with [Fabric For Repairs], it can be dyed. 
※ When crafting Costumes with [Fabric For Repairs], it will not be tradable. 

- When registering the Gesture item from Extraction, it will be registered to [Gestures] tab of your Character Skill.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/e48423535782f501c390a8b76a3b1aea308ec4ac.png[/img]

- When registering the Equalizer item from Extraction, it will be registered to [Equalizers] on your Profile [P] 
- The registered Gesture will be functioned on the Hotkey Slot as same as previous. 
- The registered Equalizer will be able to apply from the Equalizer tab as same as previous. 
* If owned Costumes equipping its own gestures or Equalizers, it will be functioned as same as previous without extraction.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/bc9a57b5c4adae09fc8151fff9c37177cd43645b.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/d377fbb9ed1dff53347f245b8dc8829bd312df4f.png[/img]

- Costumes including own gesture are limited to extract mentioned below: 
-	 Romance and Blossom 
-	 Succubus in Nightmare / Incubus in Nightmare 
- The other costumes including those two options will not be extractable. 
- Underwear, Effect Costume, Tail, Back, and Outfit Costumes that combining Top+Bottom+Hand+Shoes will not be extractable. 

[b]3. Raid Closing Notice: The Primal (Normal)[/b]
- The access portal in Golden Citadel will be removed. 
- Two quests regarding The Primal will no longer be received. 
-	 Dawn of Disaster
-	 The Night-end of Disaster 
- All playable characters’ blueprint of Dark Arbiter suit and Head Gear will be purchasable from NPC [Gruton Coin Shop]
> [Costume] > [Blueprint] below category  
- The requirement of completing the quest [How to deal with a Crisis] will be modified. 
> Level Required (Lv 55 -> Lv 68) 
-	The quest will be separated among characters and received from NPC [Brooke] in Dipluce Horizon after completing the following Main quest mentioned below: 
-	Haru, Erwin, Lily, Jin, Stella, Iris, Chii, Ephnel: ‘Marching of the Blue Light IV’ 
-	Lee Nabi: The Ways of the West    
-	 When completing Lunar Fall for 5 times, 150,000 Ether will be rewarded (Limited to 10 times)
-	Regarding the progress of quest [How to deal with a Crisis], the requirement for Monster killing count will be reset. 
-	If being conducted the quest [How to deal with a Crisis] regarding the Maze [The Primal] 10 times previously, the quest will be unable to be processed after the Update. 
-	The previous achievement and progress rate regarding The Primal will be modified to be counted upon the completion of The Primal (Hero). 
-	Previous rate values and Achievement counting will be maintained the same. 

[b]4. Extra Drops: Lunar Fall [/b]
-	When completing Lunar Fall, a treasure box will be newly added. 
-    When destroying, items including Gear/Weapon Extension and Ultimate Core will be obtained. 
-    700 BP box will be replaced as drops instead of 1000 BP box that has been dropped with random probability. 
-    [Access Pass] The Deepest Place of Void will be removed upon the completion reward of Golden Citadel (Normal/Soul) 
-    All Pass item will be worth for 20,000 Zenny when selling.
-    All registrations regarding the Pass item before the regular maintenance will be canceled. 
-    [Access Pass] The Primal (e.g. Event Reward) will be worth for 1 Zenny when selling.

-  New options will be added to the Twilight Standard Gear Set.

-	When equipping at least 3 set, a total of 9000 Critical damage will be added.

[b]---------------------------------------------◆ Events ◆---------------------------------------------[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/f5140a3cd5b60a604fd0c57f6c234c0fd6594aeb.jpg[/img]

[b]1. [Moonlight Party Event] will be carried out. (October 21st Update ~ November 11th Update) [/b]

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/2dd01f5cba2cb62d0ded9d2005f929acf2db8373.png[/img]

[b]◆ 2021 October Update Preview[/b]

[b]☞ The First Update in October[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/b518dc26b88997686f4f813c9a431f4cf0ca4b78.png[/img]

[b]▶ Corrupted Record: Iris Yuma & Jin Seipatsu[/b]

[b][Corrupted Record: Synopsis][/b]
Iris Yuma, a woman who left people behind. 
Jin Seipatsu, a man who stays to protect people. 
A tale of betrayal and malice has been silently continued in ruined camp.
How powerful the energy of Desire is, leading people to such hell, and everything got messed up by what?
The whole truth will be revealed from the last record of Grasscover Camp.

[b][3rd Corrupted Record: Iris and Jin’s Story] [/b] 
The Vacuum-based background stories of Iris Yuma and Jin Seipatsu will be newly released. 
Records titled as Corrupted Bravery, Rage, Unity, and Passion can be purchased from NPC [Corrupted Bookshelf], and new episodes will be available when using it.  
New quests regarding Corrupted Records will be accessible for characters above Lv. 68, and warp items will still be purchasable after completion of all quests mentioned above. 

[b]▶ Fusion Process for Brooches (Possession) [/b]
-  An adjustment regarding the fuse of unsellable Possession-stated brooches will be applied.
-  When fusing, five Possession-stated brooches are required and the consequence will be stated the same. 
-  Fusion Process for Possession-stated brooches will require ‘Brooch Fusion’ as same as a standard one. 

[b]▶ Possibility Increase on higher-grade Consequence of fusing brooches[/b]
-  The possibility for getting higher-graded brooches will be increased when fusing standard brooches and that of possessed in comparison to the present.

[b]▶ Update on Twilight Equipment Series Upgrade Process [/b]
     -     When upgrading, no longer destruction will be applied, and the success rate will be increased.
-	When refining, Twilight Resource will be required instead of Energy Converter.  
-	When crafting, costs and Twilight Resource requirements will be adjusted. 

[b]▶ Update on Leveling PKG [/b]
-  Level 68 PKG including ‘Supportive Primacy Gear’ will be newly updated. 
-  Disorders’ Gears from Level 65 PKG will be updated as ‘Supportive Disorders Gear’ that is distributed with random-fixed options. 
-  Devourers’ Gear from Level 60 PKG will be removed. 
-  Further includes will be partially modified. 

[b]☞ The Second Update in October[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/dc983d260fc9a9788d69fc4fbad1956cce606bc6.png[/img]

[b]▶ New Maze ‘Scary Daydream’ [/b]
-  A new daydream-themed maze ‘Scary Daydream’, which is much difficult than Second Daydream, will be newly added, 
-  In comparison to the previous background of Daydream-themed mazes, you will face such scary monsters that Setsuka dreamed of at night.  

[b]▶ Removal of The Primal Maze and update on Lunar Fall Reward[/b]
- The Primal will no longer be serviced, and its access portal will be removed. 
- Quests and requirements regarding The Primal will be modified. 
- Achievements and Progression Rate regarding The Primal will still be continued in The Primal (Hero); previous values will be maintained. 
- Main rewards from The Primal will be planned to be obtainable from Lunar Fall. 

Please look forward to our Upcoming October Update. 
Thank you. 

※ The updates in detail may be altered due to unprecedented internal issues.

notes.title: [Notice] World Boss Closing
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/92dc2400b43404a93ece1df73fe2c3b6ced82bb3.png[/img]

Hello, this is an announcement from SoulWorker. 

We are fully acknowledged that our users continuously expect the World Boss in Tenebris (EN) server that has been opened since May 13th.
The World Boss, as a time-limited content, is required much participation to defeat a huge scale of Boss, providing incomparable experience and following high quality of rewards. 
With all due respect, there are many difficulties of providing the contents in our current servers in regard to its specialty as the multiplayer-fighting content, and simultaneous accessibility from each far area/country. 
Even though we have done our best to provide the World Boss to users in Tenebris (EN) server, we concluded that it will not be able to service the contents mentioned above in a smooth environment.

As a consequence, system change will be applied to the World Boss-based rewards, enabling them to be obtainable in a different way.
SoulWorker Team sincerely apologizes for such inconvenience. 
Details are as follows:

[b]1)  Stay Connected Reward:[/b]
- Rewards for being played for 90 minutes will be replaced with the new boosting item.
The boosting will be the same benefit as 50 times defeat of The Doom and removed after 48 hours after receiving the item. Also, it can be duplicated with another boosting.
- Benefit: 
[Item Drops +25%] + [Monster Defeat EXP +15%] + [Zenny Drops +10%] 
+ [Maze Clear EXP +10%] (Duration: 60 minutes)
- Regarding this change, the previous rewards for both 30 and 60 minutes will be partially modified and the total of Stay Connected rewards will also be better supplied compared to the past. 

[b]2) Daily Mission [/b]
- Previous World Boss-based drops can be received from the completion of Daily Mission that will be newly applied. 
Reward: [District Brooch Transducer x5] + [Gear Extension x5] + [Weapon Extension x5] + [Ultimate Etherite  x2] + [BP/Familiar Random Box  x1]
- The requirement for the daily mission will be the completion of ‘Violent Sun 3 times’ and it will be continuously changed to the hardest following raid.
- With the system change mentioned above, weekly crafting restriction for Brooch from NPC [Eo] will be newly added.

All information in detail will be applied to both Rosca (TC) and Tenebris (EN) servers and planned to be conducted in the middle of October.
When being applied, the playable World Boss in Rosca (TC) will be coming to an end.
Throughout this modification applied to our system from limited contents to general gameplay, any characters bearing with Violent Sun will also get all rewards from World Boss.
Regarding this change, our goal is to provide a more comfortable and faster-reacted environment to our users. Further details will be announced on our official upcoming update note.
SoulWorker Team sincerely apologizes again for the inconvenience concerning World Boss playing, and we are looking forward that this change will be more helpful for all users’ smooth gameplay.

Thank you.

- Previous World Boss-based drops can be received from the completion of Daily Mission that will be newly applied.
- With the system change mentioned above, weekly crafting restriction for Brooch from NPC [Eo] will be newly added.

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/2dd01f5cba2cb62d0ded9d2005f929acf2db8373.png[/img]

Hello, this is an announcement from SoulWorker.
Information about 2021 September 2nd Updates taking place can be found below.

--------------------------------------------◆ Update ◆---------------------------------------------------
[b]1. New Raid ‘Violent Sun’[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/743869f8ed4f6f5d80ea33728b02023bfce33e69.png[/img]
- The new raid ‘Violent Sun’ will be newly added. (1~4 players) 

[Requirement]
- Players above level 72 can only be accessible.
- You can access ‘Violent Sun’ when proceeding and accepting the main quest ‘Crimson March III’
> The quest ‘Crimson March III can be conducted from ‘Crimson March I’ after completing ‘Unforgivable Past’

[How to Access]
- You can access the raid using ‘Maze Selection Warp System’ from NPC [Arin] in Grace City. 

[Daily Access Limitation]
- The raid ‘Violent Sun’ will be restricted to three times per character a day. 
- The access can be reset using [Access Pass] Violent Sun. 
- Party based from 1~4 players.

[Raid Information] 
- There are 3 phases in Violent Sun. 
- If you have failed to defeat Flemma in time from the 1st and 2nd phase in Violent Sun, the battle will be ended when defeating Flemma you have currently fought against. 
> The [Violent Sun Reward PKG] will be appeared if the battle did not further proceed and finished in a certain phase from the 1st to the 3rd. 
> When all players being died, rewards will not be obtainable if unable to revive. 
> The result table will appear after the destruction of the PKG mentioned above. 

- The resurrection counts are limited to three in Violent Sun Raid using the resurrector. (Being resurrected in different ways will not be counted.)
- Active Akashic Records cannot be used in Violent Sun Raid.
- The Boss ‘Flemma’ will not be influenced with extra damage status inflicted to Rapid Flame Vessi.
- Three main quests and one repeat quest concerning Violent Sun will be newly added. (Main Quest Exceptions for Lee Nabi)
> The repeat quest can be dealt with by purchasing [Violent Sun Mission Receiver] with 30,000 Zenny from the Worker Support Device: Merchant Union’s [Quest] tab stood next to [Senia] in Grace City. (Purchasable once per character a day)

- Crafting materials are newly added below:
> Fused Desire Crystal, Burning/Pale Embers, Pale Fragment, Hardening Catalyst
 - Progression Rate and rewards for Violent Sun will be newly added.

[Equipment Information] 
- New Weapon, Gear, and Accessory series ‘Pale Ashes’ can be obtained with a random possibility to clear the ‘Violent Sun’. 
- 5 Set Options will be available from the ‘Pale Ashes’ equipment series. (No concern to its category – Standard/Extend/Hero but any 4 Pale Ashes Gear + Pale Ashes Weapon)  
- Level 72 Familiar ‘Faint Light Desire’ will be newly added and can be crafted from NPC [Maxime]; can also be dismantled or recrafted.

[Additional Information]
- The Pale Ashes Frames can be obtained with a random probability to clear the ‘Violent Sun’.
 > The Pale Ashes Standard Weapon/Gear can be obtained when using it and can be tradable if not being opened.
> Obtainable from [Crafting].

- The Pale Ashes Hero Weapon/Gear can be obtained with the extremely low probability to clear the 3rd Phase of ‘Violent Sun’.
- The Hero Weapon will be obtained as ‘Pale Ashes Hero Weapon Box’ and gears are full-made. 
> When opened, the Hero Weapon that suits the character will be distributed.
> The ‘Pale Ashes Hero Weapon Box’ will be obtained by accomplishing a certain achievement.

- ‘Burning Ember’ will be obtained when dismantling Standard/Extend equipment.
- ‘Pale Ember’ will be obtained when dismantling Hero equipment.
- ‘Pale Ashes’ equipment can be obtained using those ‘Embers’ as a crafting material.
- ‘Pale Fragment’ can only be obtained from the 3rd phase of Violent Sun and used as a crafting material of ‘Pale Ember’.
- ‘Hardening Catalyst’ can be purchased with BP from NPC [Bucker TV] and used as a crafting material of ‘Pale Ember’.
- the volume of chatting has been adjusted smaller in Altar of Void, Hidden Hideout, Day-dream themed mazes, and Violent Sun. (September 6th Updated)

[b]2. New Akashic Record [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/8915297708b5577aaa881af936d74ad8483f6143.jpg[/img]
- New ★5 Akashic Record ‘Kent, god of Governance’ will be newly added.
- ‘Kent, god of Governance’ can be obtained from ‘Parable’s A.R Transmitter’.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/f988a0130f284aeb3e3250a0ed13b2d394d8ffb4.png[/img]
- The [Kent] will be newly added to A.R Special Select Option, and Parable’s A.R Transmitter [★5] that can be purchased from Mileage Shop after UPDATE. 
[h3][u][b]* Please be notified that Kent will not be selectable for the Select Option and Transmitter mentioned above purchased before update. [/b][/u][/h3]

[b]3. Parable’s A.R Transmitter [/b]
- Upcoming Akashic Records including Kent will be obtained from ‘Parable’s A.R Transmitter’ and unobtainable from the previous ‘New History’s A.R Transmitter’. 
-  All of in-game ‘New History’s A.R Transmitter’ will be replaced as ‘Parable’s A.R Transmitter.
-  Previous owned items are not replaced. 
-  Details are as follows:
 > Boss (es) Drops 
 > Attendance/ Stay Connected Reward 
 > Sales on Gruton Coin Shop 
 > Daily Mission Reward 
> Special Reward (Returnee reward, SoulWorker Sprint and Leveling Package Reward) 
* No modification applied to Progression Reward: ‘Parable’s A.R Transmitter’ will be obtainable from the upcoming contents.

 - ‘New History’s A.R Transmitter’-related packages will be newly registered as ‘Parable’s A.R Transmitter PKG’ 
- No modification applied to items purchased previously.
- Details are as follows: 
 > NEW Beginner PKG I, II, III
 > Challenger PKG
 > A.R Transmitter PKG I, II, III, III+
 > A.R Transmitter Starter PKG I, II

- Parable’s A.R Transmitter will be newly added to the crafting list of NPC [Eo]

[b]4. Other Modification[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/9bab3f5695c3015349afa4c862f36e7a3849e957.png[/img]
- Changes to the Login Screen will be made.
- The summer-themed infrastructures will be removed in Grace City. 
- The clear records of Hidden Hideout will be changed to that of the 3rd Phase in Violent Sun. 
- Incorrect descriptions in the [Help] tab have been edited.
- Chatting/Name filters will be updated. 
- ‘Additional Collection Guideline Manual [10M] will be newly added to NPC [Gruton Coin Shop] 
> Drops will be increased by 50% when using it and it can be duplicated with Lucky Day or other Manual-named items. 

- An error regarding Haru, Erwin, Lily, Jin’s Milk Cow Outfit gesture has been fixed. 
- An error regarding the tooltip of Chii’s Bloodbath has been fixed. No modification applied to the skill itself. 
- The deletion of character will now be required 336 hours (14 days – Previous in 24 hours [1 day])
- An error regarding Stella’s cinema talk has been fixed. (EN Only) 

-----------------------------------------◆ Events ◆----------------------------------------------------

[b]1. [Flemma Random Box Daily Mission Event] will be carried out. (After September 2nd Update ~ Before September 16th Update) [/b]
- Items including Lucky Day and ‘Flemma Random Box to clear the event daily mission. 
> The quest Clear Maze x1/3/5, and Clear Violent Sun x1 will be appeared if visited Candus City at least once. 
- ‘Items including Energy Converter, Anti-Destruction Device, and Fused Desire Crystal can be obtainable from ‘Flemma Random Box. 

[b]2. [Mysterious Fragment Collecting Event] will be taking off. (After September 2nd Update ~ Before September 16th Update)[/b]
- ‘[EV] Mysterious Fragment’ can be obtained by completing any maze.
  > The item can be obtained twice more than basic FP (200) – Maximum obtainable limits are 400 per day. 
- Many items can be exchangeable using the event item ‘[EV] Mysterious Fragment’ from the NPC [Gruton Coin Shop]. 

[b]3. Limited – duration items from [Vagabond of Wonderful World Event] will be unable to use.  [/b]
- Limited items obtainable from the crafting event will no longer be available for use. 

------------------------------------◆ Shop Modification ◆-----------------------------------------------

[b]1. New items and End of sales items[/b]
1) Haru, Erwin, Lily, Jin, Stella, Iris, Chii, Ephnel’s ‘Steamy Hot Springs’ will be purchasable (Indefinitely)

2) All characters ‘Followers of the Vacuum’ Costumes will be purchasable. (After September 2nd Update ~ Before September 16th Update)

3) [Female] ‘Sweet Strawberry Underwear’ will be purchasable. (Indefinitely) 

4) [Male] ‘Sweet Pineapple Underwear’ will be purchasable. (Indefinitely)

5) ‘[Access Pass] Lunar Fall will be discounted on sales. (After September 2nd Update ~ Before September 16th Update)

6) ‘[Access Pass] Violent Sun’ will be purchasable. (Indefinitely) 

7) ‘Violent Sun Challenge PKG’ will be purchasable. (After September 2nd Update ~ Before September 16th Update)
- Details are as follows:  
[Access Pass] Violent Sun x1
Blood Perfume+ x10
Iron Perfume+ x10
Flash Perfume+ x10
Lightning Perfume+ x10
Lucky Day D [1H] x1
Resurrector x20
Unique Resurrector x10

8) ‘Raid Upgrade Support Package’ will be purchasable. (After September 2nd Update ~ Before September 16th Update)
 - Details are as follows: 
Anti-Destruction Device x10
Anti-Limiter x3
Weapon Extension x50
Gear Extension x50
Ultimate Etherite x50
100,000 Ether Box x1

9) ‘Trisha's Refinement Support PKG’ will be purchasable. (After September 2nd Update ~ Before September 16th Update)
- Details are as follows: 
Corrupted Records' Appendix x 20
Energy Converter x 10
10000 BP Box x 3
Ether 50000 Box x 2

10) ‘2021 Illuminated A.R Transmitter’ item and package will be purchasable. (After September 2nd Update ~ Before September 16th Update)
- When winning the ★5 Akashic Records, it will be selected among ‘Kent, god of Governance’, ‘Beneris’, and ‘Big Puppet’ only (including Hidden) 
- The winning possibility of Normal/Hidden/★5 are equal to all of the previous A.R Transmitters including that of Parable’s, and those    three mentioned above will have the same winning probability. 

11) ‘Parable’s A.R Transmitter’ item and package will be purchasable. (Indefinitely)

12) Haru Sign and Class - Up version will be purchasable (After GMT 01:00 AM on September 9th ~ before September 16th Update)

13) ’New History’s A.R Transmitter’ item and package will not be purchasable.

Details are as follows:

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/7adcdb549abfe51a1ebfc5934a039625bb2fb588.png[/img]

[b]◆ 2021 September Update Preview [/b]

[b]☞ September 1st Update [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/743869f8ed4f6f5d80ea33728b02023bfce33e69.png[/img]

[b]▶ New Raid ‘Violent Sun’ [/b]
- Players above level 72 are accessible. 
- Signature items will be newly added. 
- Further details will be announced on upcoming Update Note. 

[b][Violent Sun] Synopsis[/b]
Rapid Flame follow the one and only rule of kneeling down to the stronger.

Flemma has knelt down before a god much stronger than he without any reason to assume otherwise. Wanting limitless power with limitless respect to those with more can commonly be spotted in Rapid Flame. 

By that logic, Flemma willingly becomes a faithful servant to he who has great power and sets off to extinguish helpless insects that stand in their way.

He was not ashamed, nor was he sad. He was not in agony, nor was he full of regret.
Instead, he was happy staring down at the so-called heroes of humanity on this gigantic battlefield the powerful one had prepared for him.

Oh, you useless god, thank you for giving me the chance to burn all these humans all at once.

This Leader of Vessi can finally indulge in the ecstasy that could not formerly be found. This place is where you and your men will see your last battle, a battlefield filled sacrificed by SoulWorkers and humans alike. 

This battlefield will be stained with the blood of humans in order to fill the savage king’s desires and his minions’ ecstasy of battle.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/8915297708b5577aaa881af936d74ad8483f6143.jpg[/img] 

[b]▶ New Akashic Records and Parable’s A.R Transmitter [/b]
- ★5 Akashic Record ‘Kent’ will be newly added. 
- Upcoming Akashic Records including Kent will be obtainable from ‘Parable’s A.R Transmitter’ and unobtainable from the previous ‘New History’s A.R Transmitter’.

 > Boss(es) Drops 
 > Attendance/ Stay Connected Reward 
 > Sales on Gruton Coin Shop 
 > Daily Mission Reward
